-- Valida que el mapa físico instanciado contenga el contrato ZoneWin completo
function ScoreService:ValidateZoneWin(session: MatchSession): boolean
	if not session or not session.InstanceInfo then
		warn("[ScoreService] MatchSession o InstanceInfo no disponibles para validación")
		return false
	end

	local info = session.InstanceInfo
	local zoneWin = info.ZoneWin
	local redWin = info.RedWin
	local blueWin = info.BlueWin

	if not zoneWin or not zoneWin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		warn(string.format("[ScoreService] Missing ZoneWin in match '%s'", session.Id))
		return false
	end

	if not redWin or not redWin:IsA("BasePart") or not redWin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		warn(string.format("[ScoreService] Missing ZoneWin.RedWin in match '%s'", session.Id))
		return false
	end

	if not blueWin or not blueWin:IsA("BasePart") or not blueWin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		warn(string.format("[ScoreService] Missing ZoneWin.BlueWin in match '%s'", session.Id))
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- Determina el equipo de un jugador dentro de la sesión (soporta 1v1 y colecciones futuras)
function ScoreService:GetPlayerTeam(session: MatchSession, player: Player): ("Red" | "Blue")?
	if not session or not player then return nil end
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService or type(roundService.GetSessionParticipant) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local participant = roundService:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, player)
	return if participant then participant.Team else nil
end

-- Valida las reglas estrictas de anotación:
-- RED + RedWin -> Válido (anota Red)
-- BLUE + BlueWin -> Válido (anota Blue)
-- RED + BlueWin -> Inválido
-- BLUE + RedWin -> Inválido
function ScoreService:_validateScorer(session: MatchSession, zoneName: string, player: Player): (boolean, ("Red" | "Blue")?)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character.Parent then return false,nil end
	local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,nil end
	if typeof(character) == "Instance" and character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false, nil end
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(session.Id) then
		return false, nil
	end
	local currentState = roundService:GetSessionState(session.Id)

	-- 1. Verificar que el match esté en Playing
	if currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then
		return false, nil
	end

	-- 2. Verificar pertenencia de equipo
	local playerTeam = self:GetPlayerTeam(session, player)
	if not playerTeam then
		-- El jugador no pertenece a esta partida
		return false, nil
	end

	-- 3. Comparar equipo con la zona física
	if playerTeam == "Red" and zoneName == "RedWin" then
		return true, "Red"
	elseif playerTeam == "Blue" and zoneName == "BlueWin" then
		return true, "Blue"
	end

	-- Cualquier otra combinación (ej. Red en BlueWin o Blue en RedWin) no anota
	return false, nil
end

-- Inicia el seguimiento de score y eventos de detección física para una sesión
function ScoreService:StartScoring(session: MatchSession)
	if not session or not session.InstanceInfo then
		warn("[ScoreService] No se puede iniciar scoring: sesión o mapa físico inválido")
		return
	end

	local matchId = session.Id
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId)
		or roundService:GetSessionById(matchId) ~= session then
		warn(string.format("[ScoreService] No se puede iniciar scoring: sesión '%s' no vigente", matchId))
		return
	end
	self:StopScoring(matchId)

	-- Inicializar score
	local score: MatchScore = {
		Red = 0,
		Blue = 0,
	}
	self._scores[matchId] = score
	session.Score = score
	self._matchPointAnnounced[matchId] = {
		Red = false,
		Blue = false,
	}
	self._playersInside[matchId] = {
		RedWin = {},
		BlueWin = {},
	}
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = false
	self._connections[matchId] = {}

	local info = session.InstanceInfo
	local redWin = info.RedWin
	local blueWin = info.BlueWin

	if not redWin or not blueWin then
		warn(string.format("[ScoreService] RedWin o BlueWin ausentes para match '%s'", matchId))
		return
	end

	-- Suscribir eventos de detección para RedWin
	self:_setupZoneEvents(session, "RedWin", redWin)

	-- Suscribir eventos de detección para BlueWin
	self:_setupZoneEvents(session, "BlueWin", blueWin)

	-- Hilo de verificación periódica para limpiar estados si el personaje sale sin disparar TouchEnded
	self._sweepThreads[matchId] = task.spawn(function()
		while self._scores[matchId] ~= nil do
			task.wait(0.25)
			if not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId)
				or roundService:GetSessionById(matchId) ~= session then break end
			self:_sweepExits(session, redWin, blueWin)
		end
	end)

	-- Hilo de detección espacial continua y robusta (segunda capa para garantizar scoring sin pérdidas por tunneling)
	self._spatialThreads[matchId] = task.spawn(function()
		while self._scores[matchId] ~= nil do
			task.wait(0.05)
			if not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId)
				or roundService:GetSessionById(matchId) ~= session then break end
			self:_checkSpatialScoring(session)
		end
	end)

	-- Emitir score inicial a los clientes
	self:_broadcastScore(matchId, score, nil, nil)

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] Scoring iniciado para Match '%s' (0 - 0)", matchId))
end

function ScoreService:_setupZoneEvents(session: MatchSession, zoneName: string, zonePart: BasePart)
	local matchId = session.Id
	local connections = self._connections[matchId]
	if not connections then return end

	local touchConn = zonePart.Touched:Connect(function(hitPart: BasePart)
		self:_onZoneTouched(session, zoneName, hitPart)
	end)
	table.insert(connections, touchConn)

	local touchEndConn = zonePart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(hitPart: BasePart)
		self:_onZoneTouchEnded(session, zoneName, zonePart, hitPart)
	end)
	table.insert(connections, touchEndConn)
end

function ScoreService:_onZoneTouched(session: MatchSession, zoneName: string, hitPart: BasePart)
	local matchId = session.Id
	local player = self:_getPlayerFromPart(hitPart)

	-- Logs de diagnóstico requeridos para validación en Studio
	if player then
		local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
		local currentState = if roundService and type(roundService.GetSessionState) == "function"
			then roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)
			else nil
		local team = self:GetPlayerTeam(session, player)
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Zone touched: %s", zoneName))
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Touching instance: %s (%s)", hitPart:GetFullName(), hitPart.ClassName))
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Resolved player: %s", player.Name))
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Player team: %s", tostring(team)))
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Match: %s", matchId))
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Match state: %s", tostring(currentState)))
	end

	self:_handleZoneScoring(session, zoneName, player, hitPart)
end

-- Manejador centralizado y atómico de anotación (llamado por Touched o por detección espacial)
function ScoreService:_handleZoneScoring(session: MatchSession, zoneName: string, player: Player?, hitPart: BasePart?)
	if not player then return end
	local matchId = session.Id

	-- 1. Operación atómica: Si la ronda de punto actual está bloqueada por reset o victoria, ignorar inmediatamente
	if self._pointInProgress[matchId] then
		return
	end

	local matchZones = self._playersInside[matchId]
	if not matchZones then return end
	local insideZone = matchZones[zoneName]
	if not insideZone then return end

	-- Si el jugador ya fue registrado dentro de esta zona en esta ronda, no volver a sumar (STAY -> NO SCORE)
	if insideZone[player] then
		return
	end

	-- 2. Validar pertenencia de equipo, estado Playing y zona correspondiente
	local isValid, team = self:_validateScorer(session, zoneName, player)
	if not isValid or not team then
		return
	end

	local score = self._scores[matchId]
 if not score then return end
 local character=player.Character
 if not character then return end
 local zone=if team=="Red" then session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.RedWin else session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.BlueWin
 if hitPart and (not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(character) or not zone
  or not ArenaRespawnPolicy.IsContactCurrent(zone.CFrame,zone.Size,hitPart.Position,hitPart.Size)) then return end
 local pointId=string.format("%s_%s_%d_%d",matchId,team,score.Red+(if team=="Red" then 1 else 0),score.Blue+(if team=="Blue" then 1 else 0))
 local elimination=self:_getEliminationService()
 -- Fail closed if the central owner is absent; never commit an unprotected goal.
 if not elimination or not elimination:TryProtectGoal(session,player,character,pointId) then return end

	-- 3. ATÓMICO: Bloquear scoring inmediatamente para prevenir dobles eventos por Touched repetido o múltiples partes
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = true

	-- Marcar al jugador como dentro de la zona
	insideZone[player] = true

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] Valid scoring entry"))

	-- Incrementar score autoritativo
	score[team] += 1
	session.Score = score

	-- Registrar atómicamente el estado del PointScorer en la sesión para RoundService y EliminationService
	session.PointInProgress = true
	session.PointScorer = player
	session.PointScorerTeam = team
	session.PointScoreTimestamp = os.clock()
	session.PointNumber = score.Red + score.Blue
		local performanceOwner = self:_getRoundService()
		if performanceOwner and performanceOwner.RecordMatchPerformance then
			performanceOwner:RecordMatchPerformance(matchId, string.format("Goal_%d_%d", score.Red, score.Blue), player, nil, nil)
		end

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] PointScorer registrado: '%s' (Equipo %s, Punto %d, Match %s)",
		player.Name, team, session.PointNumber, matchId))

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] %s score incremented", team))

	-- 4. Recompensa: Otorgar autoritativamente +50 Coins al jugador que anotó
	local rewardAmount = (Config.Match and Config.Match.PointReward) or 50
	local playerService = self:_getPlayerService()
	if playerService and playerService.AddCoins then
		playerService:AddCoins(player, rewardAmount, "MatchPoint", "Goal:" .. pointId)
	end

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] ¡ANOTACIÓN! %s anotó para %s (+%d Coins). Nuevo Score: Red=%d, Blue=%d",
		player.Name, team, rewardAmount, score.Red, score.Blue))

	-- 5. Emitir actualización a los clientes
	self:_broadcastScore(matchId, score, team, player.Name)

	-- 6. Disparar presentación audiovisual a través de PointFeedbackService
	local winningScore = (Config.Match and Config.Match.WinningScore) or 5
	local isFinalPoint = (score[team] >= winningScore)
	local scoringZone = if team == "Red"
		then (session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.RedWin)
		else (session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.BlueWin)
		-- Pass presentation data to the existing terminal owner; never replay scoring.
		if isFinalPoint then
			local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
			if roundService then roundService:DeclareSessionWinner(matchId, team, {
				PointId = string.format("%s_%s_%d_%d", matchId, team, score.Red, score.Blue),
				MatchId = matchId, ScoringTeam = team, ScoringPlayer = player,
				ScoringZone = scoringZone, IsFinalPoint = true, RedScore = score.Red, BlueScore = score.Blue,
			}) end
		end

	local pointFeedbackService = self:_getPointFeedbackService()
	if not session.GameplayFrozen and pointFeedbackService and pointFeedbackService.PlayPoint then
		local pointId = string.format("%s_%s_%d_%d", matchId, team, score.Red, score.Blue)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			pointFeedbackService:PlayPoint(session, {
				PointId = pointId,
				MatchId = matchId,
				ScoringTeam = team,
				ScoringPlayer = player,
				ScoringZone = scoringZone :: any,
				IsFinalPoint = isFinalPoint,
				RedScore = score.Red,
				BlueScore = score.Blue,
			})
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[ScoreService] Error no fatal al invocar PointFeedbackService: %s", tostring(err)))
		end
	end

	-- 7. Chequeo de Match Point (WinningScore - 1)
	if score[team] == winningScore - 1 then
		local announced = self._matchPointAnnounced[matchId]
		if announced and not announced[team] then
			announced[team] = true
			self:_broadcastLastPoint(matchId, team)
		end
	end

	-- 8. Chequeo de Victoria Inmediata al alcanzar WinningScore (5)
	if isFinalPoint then
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] ¡%s ALCANZÓ EL WINNING SCORE (%d)! Victoria inmediata.", team, winningScore))
		-- NO se realiza reset de posiciones al alcanzar winningScore (la partida pasa inmediatamente a Ending)
		return
	end

	-- 9. Si aún no se alcanza WinningScore, coordinar PointRestartCountdown con RoundService
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if roundService and roundService.TriggerPointRestart then
		roundService:TriggerPointRestart(session)
	else
		self:_schedulePointReset(session)
	end
end

-- Segunda capa de detección: Consulta espacial continua para evitar pérdidas por tunneling/velocidad en Touched
function ScoreService:_checkSpatialScoring(session: MatchSession)
	local matchId = session.Id
	if self._pointInProgress[matchId] then return end
	if not session.InstanceInfo then return end

	local redWin = session.InstanceInfo.RedWin
	local blueWin = session.InstanceInfo.BlueWin
	if not redWin or not blueWin then return end

	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId) then return end
	local currentState = roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)
	if currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then return end

	local redPlayers: { Player } = {}
	local bluePlayers: { Player } = {}
	for _, participant in ipairs(session.Participants) do
		if roundService:GetSessionParticipant(matchId, participant.Player) == participant then
			if participant.Team == "Red" then
				table.insert(redPlayers, participant.Player)
			else
				table.insert(bluePlayers, participant.Player)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Verificar Red en RedWin
	for _, player in ipairs(redPlayers) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char and char.Parent and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
				overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
				local parts = workspace:GetPartsInPart(redWin, overlapParams)
				if #parts > 0 then
					self:_handleZoneScoring(session, "RedWin", player, parts[1])
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Verificar Blue en BlueWin
	for _, player in ipairs(bluePlayers) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char and char.Parent and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
				overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
				local parts = workspace:GetPartsInPart(blueWin, overlapParams)
				if #parts > 0 then
					self:_handleZoneScoring(session, "BlueWin", player, parts[1])
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function ScoreService:_schedulePointReset(session: MatchSession)
	local matchId = session.Id

	-- Cancelar cualquier hilo previo si existiera
	local prevThread = self._resetThreads[matchId]
	if prevThread then
		pcall(task.cancel, prevThread)
	end

	self._resetThreads[matchId] = task.spawn(function()
		local delayTime = (Config.Match and Config.Match.PointResetDelay) or 1.5
		task.wait(delayTime)

		-- Validar que la partida siga activa y en estado Playing
		if not self._scores[matchId] then return end
		local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
		if not roundService or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
			or not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId)
			or roundService:GetSessionById(matchId) ~= session
			or roundService:GetSessionState(matchId) ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then return end

		-- Reposicionar ambos equipos en sus spawns respectivos de la arena activa
		local spawnService = self:_getSpawnService()
		if not spawnService then return end
		local result=spawnService:SpawnMatchPlayers(session)
		if not result.Success then return end

		-- Limpiar registro de presencia en zonas para la nueva ronda de punto
		self._playersInside[matchId] = {
			RedWin = {},
			BlueWin = {},
		}

		-- Breve margen de estabilización física antes de reabrir scoring
		task.wait(0.2)
		if not self._scores[matchId]
			or not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId)
			or roundService:GetSessionById(matchId) ~= session
			or roundService:GetSessionState(matchId) ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then return end

		self:ResumeScoring(matchId)
		self._resetThreads[matchId] = nil
		print(string.format("[ScoreService] Nueva ronda de punto iniciada para Match '%s'. Score acumulado: Red=%d, Blue=%d",
			matchId, session.Score.Red, session.Score.Blue))
	end)
end

function ScoreService:_onZoneTouchEnded(session: MatchSession, zoneName: string, zonePart: BasePart, hitPart: BasePart)
	local matchId = session.Id
	local player = self:_getPlayerFromPart(hitPart)
	if not player then return end

	local matchZones = self._playersInside[matchId]
	if not matchZones then return end
	local insideZone = matchZones[zoneName]
	if not insideZone or not insideZone[player] then return end

	-- Verificar si el personaje realmente salió por completo de la zona
	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		insideZone[player] = nil
		return
	end

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }

	local touchingParts = workspace:GetPartsInPart(zonePart, overlapParams)
	if #touchingParts == 0 then
		insideZone[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Limpieza periódica para detectar salidas de personajes que no dispararon TouchEnded
function ScoreService:_sweepExits(session: MatchSession, redWin: BasePart, blueWin: BasePart)
	local matchId = session.Id
	local matchZones = self._playersInside[matchId]
	if not matchZones then return end

	local checkZone = function(zoneName: string, zonePart: BasePart)
		local insideZone = matchZones[zoneName]
		if not insideZone then return end

		for player, isInside in pairs(insideZone) do
			if isInside then
				local character = player.Character
				if not character or not character.Parent or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
					insideZone[player] = nil
				else
					local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
					overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
					overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
					local touching = workspace:GetPartsInPart(zonePart, overlapParams)
					if #touching == 0 then
						insideZone[player] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if redWin and redWin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		checkZone("RedWin", redWin)
	end
	if blueWin and blueWin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		checkZone("BlueWin", blueWin)
	end
end

	local matchId = session.Id
	local score = self._scores[matchId] or session.Score
	if not score then
		return Constants.MatchResult.Draw
	end

	if score.Red > score.Blue then
		return Constants.MatchResult.Red
	elseif score.Blue > score.Red then
		return Constants.MatchResult.Blue
	else
		return Constants.MatchResult.Draw
	end

	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = false
	self:ClearPointState(matchId)
end

-- Limpia de forma explícita el estado temporal de PointScorer asociado a la sesión del match
function ScoreService:ClearPointState(matchId: string)
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = false
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local session = nil
	if roundService and type(roundService.GetSessionById) == "function" then
		session = roundService:GetSessionById(matchId)
	end
	if session then
		session.PointInProgress = false
		session.PointScorer = nil
		session.PointScorerTeam = nil
		session.PointScoreTimestamp = nil
		session.PointNumber = nil
	end
end

-- Pausa temporal de scoring durante secuencias o pausas
function ScoreService:PauseScoring(matchId: string)
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = true
end

-- Detiene el scoring y desconecta eventos físicos
function ScoreService:StopScoring(matchId: string)
	self:ClearPointState(matchId)
	local conns = self._connections[matchId]
	if conns then
		for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		self._connections[matchId] = nil
	end

	local thread = self._sweepThreads[matchId]
	if thread then
		pcall(task.cancel, thread)
		self._sweepThreads[matchId] = nil
	end

	local spatialThread = self._spatialThreads[matchId]
	if spatialThread then
		pcall(task.cancel, spatialThread)
		self._spatialThreads[matchId] = nil
	end

	local resetThread = self._resetThreads[matchId]
	if resetThread then
		pcall(task.cancel, resetThread)
		self._resetThreads[matchId] = nil
	end

	self._playersInside[matchId] = nil
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = nil
end

-- Limpieza total de recursos de una partida
function ScoreService:CleanupSession(matchId: string)
	self:StopScoring(matchId)
	self._scores[matchId] = nil
	self._matchPointAnnounced[matchId] = nil
	self._pointInProgress[matchId] = nil

	local pointFeedbackService = self:_getPointFeedbackService()
	if pointFeedbackService and pointFeedbackService.CleanupMatch then
		pointFeedbackService:CleanupMatch(matchId)
	end

	print(string.format("[ScoreService] Limpieza completada para Match '%s'", matchId))
end

return ScoreService

	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	local current: Instance? = part
	while current and current ~= workspace do

	end
	return nil

-- Vincula la detección de KillParts, VoidBoundary y muertes a una MatchSession activa

function EliminationService:TryProtectGoal(session: MatchSession, player: Player, character: Model, pointId: string): boolean
 if self:_getActiveSession(session.Id) ~= session or session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then return false end
 if not self:_getParticipant(session.Id,player) or player.Character~=character or not character.Parent then return false end
 if character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false end

 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false end
 return self._transits:Claim(session,player,character,character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0,"Goal",pointId)
end

function EliminationService:BindMatch(session: MatchSession)
	if not session or not session.Id then return end
	local matchId = session.Id
	if self:_getActiveSession(matchId) ~= session then return end
	self:UnbindMatch(matchId)

	local conns: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	self._connections[matchId] = conns

	-- 1. Vincular partes de eliminación física (KillParts) como sensores no letales
	local killParts: { BasePart } = {}
	if session.InstanceInfo then
		if session.InstanceInfo.KillParts and #session.InstanceInfo.KillParts > 0 then
			killParts = session.InstanceInfo.KillParts
		elseif session.InstanceInfo.InstanceModel then
			for _, desc in ipairs(session.InstanceInfo.InstanceModel:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc.Name == "KillPart" then
					table.insert(killParts, desc)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, killPart in ipairs(killParts) do
		local conn = killPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
			self:HandleKillPartTouch(killPart, otherPart, session)
		end)
		table.insert(conns, conn)
	end

	-- 2. Vincular sensor de límite de vacío (VoidBoundaryPart) como sensor no letal
	if session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.VoidBoundaryPart then
		local voidBoundary = session.InstanceInfo.VoidBoundaryPart
		local voidConn = voidBoundary.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
			self:HandleVoidBoundaryTouch(voidBoundary, otherPart, session)
		end)
		table.insert(conns, voidConn)
	end

	-- 3. Escuchar Humanoid.Died en modo diagnóstico pasivo (Fase 4B Zero-Death)
	local trackPlayerDeath = function(player: Player)
		if not player then return end

		local function onCharacter(character: Model)
			self._transits:ForgetPlayer(matchId,player)
			table.insert(conns, character.Destroying:Connect(function()
				if player.Character==character then self._transits:ForgetPlayer(matchId,player) end
			end))
			local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5) :: Humanoid?
			if hum then
				local diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
					warn(string.format("[EliminationService] [DIAGNOSTIC] Humanoid.Died detectado en '%s' durante Match '%s'. Evento absorbido pasivamente por Zero-Death (sin scoring, sin respawn).",
						player.Name, matchId))
				end)
				table.insert(conns, diedConn)
			end
		end

		if player.Character then
			onCharacter(player.Character)
		end
		table.insert(conns, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() self._transits:ForgetPlayer(matchId,player) end))
		table.insert(conns, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MatchId"):Connect(function()
			if player:GetAttribute("MatchId")~=matchId then self._transits:ForgetPlayer(matchId,player) end
		end))
		local charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
		table.insert(conns, charConn)
	end

	for _, participant in ipairs(session.Participants) do
		if self:_getParticipant(matchId, participant.Player) == participant then
			trackPlayerDeath(participant.Player)
		end
	end

	-- Registrar sesión activa y arrancar polling fail-safe si corresponde
	self._activeSessions[matchId] = session
	self:_startPollingIfNeeded()

	print(string.format("[EliminationService] Vinculación completada para Match '%s' (%d KillParts, VoidBoundary: %s)",
		matchId, #killParts, tostring(session.InstanceInfo and session.InstanceInfo.VoidBoundaryPart ~= nil)))
end

-- Desvincula los listeners y limpia el registro de una partida finalizada
function EliminationService:UnbindMatch(matchId: string)
	if not matchId then return end
	self._transits:ClearSession(matchId)
	local spawn = self:_getSpawnService()
	if spawn and spawn.CancelSessionRespawns then spawn:CancelSessionRespawns(matchId, "MatchUnbound") end

	local conns = self._connections[matchId]
	if conns then
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		self._connections[matchId] = nil
	end

	-- Desregistrar sesión activa y detener polling si no quedan partidas
	self._activeSessions[matchId] = nil
	if next(self._activeSessions) == nil then
		self:_stopPolling()
	end

	-- Limpiar claves resueltas asociadas al matchId
	local prefix = matchId .. "_"
	for key, _ in pairs(self._resolvedEliminations) do
		if string.sub(key, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			self._resolvedEliminations[key] = nil
		end
	end

	-- Limpiar debounces y contadores temporales de jugadores desconectados
	for player, _ in pairs(self._processingEliminations) do
		if not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			self._processingEliminations[player] = nil
		end
	end
	for player, _ in pairs(self._eliminationCounters) do
		if not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			self._eliminationCounters[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Procesa el contacto con un KillPart como sensor de eliminación/caída (Humanoid.Health intacto)
function EliminationService:HandleKillPartTouch(killPart: BasePart, hitPart: BasePart, session: MatchSession)
	local player = getPlayerFromPart(hitPart)
	if not player then return end
	if not ArenaRespawnPolicy.IsContactCurrent(killPart.CFrame, killPart.Size, hitPart.Position, hitPart.Size) then return end
	self:_processEliminationEvent(player, session, "KillPart", killPart, hitPart)
end

-- Procesa el contacto con el sensor VoidBoundaryPart de la arena (Humanoid.Health intacto)
function EliminationService:HandleVoidBoundaryTouch(voidBoundary: BasePart, hitPart: BasePart, session: MatchSession)
	local player = getPlayerFromPart(hitPart)
	if not player then return end
	if not ArenaRespawnPolicy.IsContactCurrent(voidBoundary.CFrame, voidBoundary.Size, hitPart.Position, hitPart.Size) then return end
	self:_processEliminationEvent(player, session, "VoidBoundary", voidBoundary, hitPart)
end

-- Núcleo unificado de procesamiento autoritativo de salida / eliminación sin muerte física
function EliminationService:_processEliminationEvent(player: Player, session: MatchSession, source: string, boundaryPart: BasePart?, hitPart: BasePart?)
	-- 1. Validar que la instancia sea un Player conectado
	if not player or not isPlayer(player) or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then return end

	-- 2. Validar que la sesión esté activa y en estado válido para el lifecycle
	if not session or not session.Id then return end
	local matchId = session.Id

	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if self:_getActiveSession(matchId) ~= session then return end
	local currentState = roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)

	-- Estados permitidos: Playing, PointRestartCountdown, StartCountdown, Ending
	if currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing
		and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown
		and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown
		and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Ending then
		return
	end

	-- 3. Validar pertenencia estricta del jugador a este match específico
	if not self:_getParticipant(matchId, player) then return end
	local respawnOwner = self:_getSpawnService()
	if respawnOwner and respawnOwner.IsKillPartRespawnPending and respawnOwner:IsKillPartRespawnPending(player) then return end

	-- 4. Multi-match isolation: Validar que el boundaryPart pertenezca al contenedor de esta MatchInstance
	if boundaryPart and session.InstanceInfo then
		local container = session.InstanceInfo.Container
		if container and not boundaryPart:IsDescendantOf(container) then
			-- El sensor tocado pertenece a otra arena
			return
		end
	end

	-- Reject the exact already-resolved transit BEFORE debounce, attribution, awards or feedback.
 local character = player.Character
 if not character or not character.Parent then return end
 if hitPart and not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(character) then return end
 local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return end
 local generation=character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0
 local resolved=self._transits:Get(session,player,character,generation)
 if resolved then
  if Config.Respawn.Debug then print("[ScoreKillPart] ContactSuppressed",matchId,player.UserId,resolved.Kind,resolved.EventId,generation,source) end
  return
 end

 -- Existing debounce remains for accepted elimination attempts only.
 local now=os.clock()
 local lastTouch=self._processingEliminations[player]
 if lastTouch and now-lastTouch<0.5 then return end
 self._processingEliminations[player]=now

	-- First validated authority wins; no callback/yield before reserving this life.
 if not self._transits:Claim(session,player,character,generation,"Elimination",source) then return end

	-- Capture contact BEFORE ResetCharacterInArena; never read a later spawn position in the feed.
	local impactCFrame: CFrame? = nil
		if boundaryPart then
			local impactPart = hitPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if impactPart then impactCFrame = DeathFeedbackContract.ImpactCFrame(boundaryPart.CFrame, boundaryPart.Size, impactPart.Position) end
	end
	local rewardCoins = 0

	-- 8. Resolver atacante en CombatService (solo elegible durante Playing o PointRestartCountdown)
	local combatEligible = (currentState == Constants.RoundState.Playing or currentState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown)
	local combatService = self:_getCombatService()
	local killer: Player? = nil

	if combatEligible and combatService and type(combatService.GetLastAttacker) == "function" then
		local attacker, attackerMatchId = combatService:GetLastAttacker(
			player,
			(Config.Combat and Config.Combat.LastHitLifetime) or 10
		)

		if attacker and attacker ~= player and isPlayer(attacker) and attacker.Parent
			and attackerMatchId == matchId
			and self:_isOpposingParticipant(matchId, attacker, player) then
			killer = attacker
		end
	end

	-- 9. Clasificación del evento: CombatElimination vs Normal Fall
	local counter = (self._eliminationCounters[player] or 0) + 1
	self._eliminationCounters[player] = counter
	local elimKey = string.format("%s_%d_%d", matchId, player.UserId, counter)
		-- Resolve the victim cosmetic and immutable presentation identity BEFORE retirement.
		local effectId = DeathFeedbackContract.ResolveEffect(self:_getPlayerService(), player, killer ~= nil, DeathEffectCatalog, DeathFeedbackSettings.DeathEffects)
		local feedbackSnapshot = table.freeze({
			SessionId=matchId, StateVersion=session.StateVersion, EliminationId=elimKey,
			VictimUserId=player.UserId, VictimName=player.DisplayName,
			KillerUserId=killer and killer.UserId, KillerName=killer and killer.DisplayName,
			EffectId=effectId, ImpactCFrame=impactCFrame, Reason=source,
			Kind=if killer then "CreditedKill" else "UnattributedFall",
			Generation=character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0,
		})
		if Config.Respawn.Debug then print("[RespawnDebug] EliminationConfirmed",matchId,elimKey,player.UserId,feedbackSnapshot.Generation,currentState,source,killer and killer.UserId,effectId) end
	local deferredRespawn = false
		if currentState == Constants.RoundState.Playing
		and respawnOwner and respawnOwner.BeginKillPartRespawn then
		-- Identity/impact/attacker are already captured. Retire now, before any downstream callbacks.
			-- Touched and void polling must use the SAME retirement/quiet recovery path.
			deferredRespawn = respawnOwner:BeginKillPartRespawn(player, session, elimKey, source .. (if killer then "_Kill" else "_NormalFall"))
	end

	if killer then
		-- CASO A: COMBAT ELIMINATION (+1 Kill)
		if not self._resolvedEliminations[elimKey] then
			self._resolvedEliminations[elimKey] = true
				-- Deaths means accepted competitive eliminations, never normal zero-death falls.
				if roundService.RecordMatchPerformance then
					roundService:RecordMatchPerformance(matchId, "Elimination_" .. elimKey, nil, killer, player)
				end

			local playerService = self:_getPlayerService()
			if playerService and type(playerService.AddKill) == "function" then
					playerService:AddKill(killer, 1, "SlapElimination")
					if type(playerService.AwardConfirmedKill) == "function" then
						-- Credit once by EliminationId; only the committed amount enters the visual receipt.
						rewardCoins = playerService:AwardConfirmedKill(killer, player, matchId, elimKey)
					end
			end

			print(string.format("[EliminationService] COMBAT ELIMINATION (%s): '%s' eliminó a '%s' (+1 Kill) en Match '%s'",
				source, killer.Name, player.Name, matchId))

			-- Limpiar CombatTag consumido
			if combatService and type(combatService.ClearCombatTag) == "function" then
				combatService:ClearCombatTag(player)
			end

			-- Emitir BindableEvent para sistemas de estadísticas y feed
			local record: EliminationRecord = {
				Victim = player,
				Killer = killer,
				MatchId = matchId,
				Timestamp = now,
				Reason = source,
				EliminationId = elimKey,
					FeedbackSnapshot = feedbackSnapshot,
					ImpactCFrame = impactCFrame,
					RewardCoins = rewardCoins,
					StateVersion = session.StateVersion,
					ConfirmedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
			}
			playerEliminatedBindable:Fire(record)
		end
	else
		-- CASO B: NORMAL FALL (+0 Kill)
		print(string.format("[EliminationService] NORMAL FALL (%s): '%s' cayó sin atacante en Match '%s' (Estado: %s)",
			source, player.Name, matchId, tostring(currentState)))

		-- Limpiar CombatTag residual si existiese
		if combatService and type(combatService.ClearCombatTag) == "function" then
			combatService:ClearCombatTag(player)
		end

		local record: EliminationRecord = {
			Victim = player,
			Killer = nil,
			MatchId = matchId,
			Timestamp = now,
			Reason = source .. "_NormalFall",
			EliminationId = elimKey,
				FeedbackSnapshot = feedbackSnapshot,
			ImpactCFrame = impactCFrame,
			RewardCoins = 0,
				StateVersion = session.StateVersion,
				ConfirmedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		}
		playerEliminatedBindable:Fire(record)
	end

	-- 10. Reposicionamiento del Character EXISTENTE sin matar Humanoid ni recargar rig
	local spawnService = self:_getSpawnService()
	if not deferredRespawn and spawnService and type(spawnService.ResetCharacterInArena) == "function" then
		spawnService:ResetCharacterInArena(player)
	end
end

-- ==================================================
-- POLLING FAIL-SAFE DE CAÍDAS AL VACÍO (Fase 3B)
-- ==================================================

function EliminationService:_startPollingIfNeeded()
	if self._isPolling then return end
	self._isPolling = true
	self._pollThread = task.spawn(function()
		self:_pollActiveSessions()
	end)
end

function EliminationService:_stopPolling()
	self._isPolling = false
	if self._pollThread then
		task.cancel(self._pollThread)
		self._pollThread = nil
	end
end

-- Chequeo periódico exclusivo sobre participantes de partidas activas
function EliminationService:_pollActiveSessions()
	local pollInterval = (Config.Arena and Config.Arena.VoidBoundaryPollInterval) or 0.2

	while self._isPolling do
		task.wait(pollInterval)
		if not self._isPolling then break end

		for matchId, session in pairs(self._activeSessions) do
			if not session or not session.InstanceInfo then continue end
			if self:_getActiveSession(matchId) ~= session then continue end
			local boundaryPart = session.InstanceInfo.VoidBoundaryPart
			if not boundaryPart or not boundaryPart.Parent then continue end

			local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
			local currentState = roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)
			if currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing
				and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown
				and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown
				and currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Ending then
				continue
			end

			-- Criterio de altura: relativa a la geometría del VoidBoundary de esta MatchInstance
			local thresholdY = boundaryPart.Position.Y + (boundaryPart.Size.Y * 0.5)

			local playersToCheck: { Player } = {}
			for _, participant in ipairs(session.Participants) do
				if self:_getParticipant(matchId, participant.Player) == participant then
					table.insert(playersToCheck, participant.Player)
				end
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			for _, player in ipairs(playersToCheck) do
				if not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then continue end

				-- Descarte rápido si ya está en procesamiento activo por Touched
				local lastTouch = self._processingEliminations[player]
				if lastTouch and (now - lastTouch) < 0.5 then
					continue
				end

				local character = player.Character
				if not character or not character.Parent then continue end
				local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
				if not hrp then continue end

				if hrp.Position.Y <= thresholdY then
					self:_processEliminationEvent(player, session, "VoidBoundaryPolling", boundaryPart)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Invocado cuando un jugador es eliminado; resuelve la atribución de Kill de forma segura
function EliminationService:OnPlayerEliminated(victim: Player, reason: string, overrideMatchId: string?): (boolean, Player?)
	-- 1. Validar que la víctima exista y sea Player
	if not isPlayer(victim) then
		return false, nil
	end

	-- 2. Resolver y validar MatchId
	local matchId = overrideMatchId
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local session: MatchSession? = nil

	if matchId then
		if roundService and type(roundService.GetSessionById) == "function" then
			session = roundService:GetSessionById(matchId)
		end
	else
		if roundService and type(roundService.GetSessionForPlayer) == "function" then
			session = roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(victim)
			if session then
				matchId = session.Id
			end
		end
	end

	if not matchId or not session then
		-- Jugador fuera de partida o match no encontrado
		return false, nil
	end
	if self:_getActiveSession(matchId) ~= session or not self:_getParticipant(matchId, victim) then
		return false, nil
	end

	-- En arquitectura Zero-Death, las eliminaciones autoritativas ocurren exclusivamente via KillPart/VoidBoundary
	local currentState = roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)
	if currentState == Constants.RoundState.Playing or currentState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown then
		warn(string.format("[EliminationService] [DIAGNOSTIC] OnPlayerEliminated invocado para '%s' (Razón: %s) en partida Zero-Death. Se descarta scoring o respawn secundario.",
			victim.Name, tostring(reason)))
		return false, nil
	end

	-- 3. Validar que la partida no esté cancelada ni terminada
	if session.Result == "Cancelled" then
		return false, nil
	end

	local currentCharacter=victim.Character
 if currentCharacter and self._transits:Get(session,victim,currentCharacter,currentCharacter:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) then return false,nil end

	-- 4. ANTI-DUPLICATE CHECK: Cada eliminación produce exactamente 1 resolución
	local char = victim.Character
	local charId = if char then tostring(char:GetDebugId()) else tostring(victim.UserId)
	local elimKey = string.format("%s_%d_%s", matchId, victim.UserId, charId)

	if self._resolvedEliminations[elimKey] then
		-- Ya fue resuelta para este personaje / ciclo de vida
		return false, nil
	end
	self._resolvedEliminations[elimKey] = true

	-- 5. Resolver el último atacante válido mediante CombatService
	local combatService = self:_getCombatService()
	local killer: Player? = nil

	if combatService and type(combatService.GetLastAttacker) == "function" then
		local attacker, attackerMatchId, _hitTimestamp = combatService:GetLastAttacker(
			victim,
			(Config.Combat and Config.Combat.LastHitLifetime) or 10
		)

		-- 6. Validaciones estrictas sobre el atacante
		if attacker and attacker ~= victim and isPlayer(attacker) and attacker.Parent
			and attackerMatchId == matchId
			and self:_isOpposingParticipant(matchId, attacker, victim) then
			killer = attacker
		end
	end

	-- 7. Limpiar CombatTag de la víctima para no reutilizar impactos previos
	if combatService and type(combatService.ClearCombatTag) == "function" then
		combatService:ClearCombatTag(victim)
	end

	-- 8. Atribución autoritativa de Kill si existe atacante válido
	if killer then
		local playerService = self:_getPlayerService()
		if playerService and type(playerService.AddKill) == "function" then
			playerService:AddKill(killer, 1, "SlapElimination")
		end

		print(string.format("[EliminationService] KILL CONFIRMADA: '%s' eliminó a '%s' en Match '%s' (Razón: %s)",
			killer.Name, victim.Name, matchId, reason or "KillPart"))
	else
		print(string.format("[EliminationService] Eliminación de '%s' en Match '%s' sin atacante válido (Razón: %s)",
			victim.Name, matchId, reason or "Fall/Suicide"))
	end

	-- 9. Emitir registro a través del BindableEvent
	local record: EliminationRecord = {
		Victim = victim,
		Killer = killer,
		MatchId = matchId,
		Timestamp = os.clock(),
		Reason = reason or "Unknown",
		EliminationId = elimKey,
	}
	playerEliminatedBindable:Fire(record)

	return true, killer
end

return EliminationService

-- - Registrar impactos válidos (Slaps) entre jugadores en una partida.

function CombatService:_getRoundService(): any

	if self._context and type(self._context.GetService) == "function" then

	end

local function isPlayer(p: any): boolean
	if not p then return false end
	if typeof(p) == "Instance" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	if (typeof(p) == "userdata" or typeof(p) == "table") and type(p.IsA) == "function" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	return false
end

-- Registra un impacto de combate válido entre dos jugadores
function CombatService:RegisterHit(attacker: Player, victim: Player, overrideMatchId: string?): (boolean, string?)
	-- 1. Validar que ambos jugadores existan y sean instancias Player
	if not isPlayer(attacker) then
		return false, "InvalidAttacker"
	end
	if not isPlayer(victim) then
		return false, "InvalidVictim"
	end

	-- 2. Validar que attacker ~= victim (rechazar auto-ataque)
	if attacker == victim then
		return false, "SelfAttack"
	end

	-- 3. Validar que sigan en el DataModel
	if not attacker.Parent or not victim.Parent then
		return false, "PlayerNotDescendant"
	end
	for _, player in ipairs({ attacker, victim }) do
		local character = player.Character
		if typeof(character) == "Instance" and character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then
			return false, "ParticipantRespawning"
		end
	end

	-- 4. Resolver y validar MatchId
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService then
		return false, "RoundServiceUnavailable"
	end

	local victimSession = self:_resolveSession(victim)
	local matchId = overrideMatchId or (victimSession and victimSession.Id)
	local session: MatchSession? = if matchId and type(roundService.GetSessionById) == "function"
		then roundService:GetSessionById(matchId)
		else nil

	if not matchId or not session then
		return false, "NotInMatch"
	end
	if session.Closing or session.Cancelled or session.Closed then
		return false, "SessionClosing"
	end

	-- 5. Validar identidad, vigencia y estado de la sesión explícita
	if victimSession ~= session
		or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(matchId) then
		return false, "DifferentMatch"
	end
	local currentState = if type(roundService.GetSessionState) == "function"
		then roundService:GetSessionState(matchId)
		else nil
	if currentState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then
		return false, "MatchNotPlaying"
	end

	-- 6. Validar que AMBOS pertenezcan al mismo MatchId
	local attackerSession = self:_resolveSession(attacker)
	if attackerSession ~= session then
		return false, "DifferentMatch"
	end
	if type(roundService.GetSessionParticipant) ~= "function" then
		return false, "ParticipantRegistryUnavailable"
	end
	local attackerParticipant = roundService:GetSessionParticipant(matchId, attacker)
	local victimParticipant = roundService:GetSessionParticipant(matchId, victim)
	if not attackerParticipant or not victimParticipant then
		return false, "NotInMatch"
	end
	if attackerParticipant.State == "Left" or attackerParticipant.State == "Released"
		or victimParticipant.State == "Left" or victimParticipant.State == "Released" then
		return false, "ParticipantInactive"
	end
	if attackerParticipant.Team == victimParticipant.Team then
		return false, "SameTeam"
	end

	-- 7. Registrar o actualizar CombatTag autoritativo
	local timestamp = os.clock()
	local tag: CombatTag = {
		Victim = victim,
		Attacker = attacker,
		MatchId = matchId,
		Timestamp = timestamp,
		HitId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
	}

	self._tags[victim] = tag

	-- 8. Registrar en historial para futuras asistencias y métricas
	if not self._history[victim] then
		self._history[victim] = {}
	end
	table.insert(self._history[victim], {
		Attacker = attacker,
		Timestamp = timestamp,
		Damage = 0,
	})

	print(string.format("[CombatService] Hit registrado: '%s' golpeó a '%s' en Match '%s'",
		attacker.Name, victim.Name, matchId))

	return true, nil
end

-- Retorna el CombatTag activo de una víctima
function CombatService:GetCombatTag(victim: Player): CombatTag?
	if not victim then return nil end
	return self._tags[victim]
end

-- Resuelve el último atacante válido de una víctima considerando ventana de expiración
function CombatService:GetLastAttacker(victim: Player, maxLifetime: number?): (Player?, string?, number?)
	if not victim then return nil, nil, nil end

	local tag = self._tags[victim]
	if not tag then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	-- Validar ventana de expiración (LastHitLifetime)
	local lifetime = maxLifetime or (Config.Combat and Config.Combat.LastHitLifetime) or 10
	local elapsed = os.clock() - tag.Timestamp
	if elapsed > lifetime then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	-- Validar que el atacante siga siendo un Player válido en el juego
	local attacker = tag.Attacker
	if not isPlayer(attacker) or not attacker.Parent then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end

	return attacker, tag.MatchId, tag.Timestamp
end

-- Limpia el CombatTag de una víctima tras una eliminación o reset
function CombatService:ClearCombatTag(victim: Player)
	if not victim then return end
	self._tags[victim] = nil
	self._history[victim] = nil
end

-- Limpia todos los CombatTags e historial de una partida
function CombatService:ClearMatch(matchId: string)
	if not matchId then return end
	for victim, tag in pairs(self._tags) do
		if tag.MatchId == matchId then
			self._tags[victim] = nil
			self._history[victim] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Retorna el historial de impactos recibidos por una víctima (para futuras asistencias)
function CombatService:GetHitHistory(victim: Player): { CombatHitHistoryItem }
	if not victim or not self._history[victim] then
		return {}
	end
	return table.clone(self._history[victim])
end

return CombatService

--
-- Principios arquitectonicos:
-- 1. Separacion total entre ASSET (modelo/configuracion en ServerStorage.Slaps) y LOGICA DE COMBATE (este servicio).

	if self._combatService then return self._combatService end

local function ensureFolder(parent: Instance, name: string): Folder
	local f = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = name
		f.Parent = parent
	end
	return f :: Folder
end

local function ensureRemoteEvent(parent: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local ev = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not ev then
		ev = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		ev.Name = name
		ev.Parent = parent
	end
	return ev :: RemoteEvent
end

function SlapService:_ensureRemotes()
	local remotesFolder = ensureFolder(ReplicatedStorage, "Remotes")
	local combatFolder = ensureFolder(remotesFolder, "Combat")
	self._performSlapRemote = ensureRemoteEvent(combatFolder, "PerformSlap")
end

	if slaps and slaps:IsA("Folder") then
		return slaps
	end
	return nil
end

function SlapService:GetSlapTemplate(slapName: string): Tool?
	local slapsFolder = self:GetSlapsFolder()
	if not slapsFolder then return nil end
	local template = slapsFolder:FindFirstChild(slapName)
	if template and template:IsA("Tool") then
		return template
	end
	return nil
end

-- Identifica de forma autoritativa si una herramienta es un Slap administrado por SlapService
function SlapService:IsSlapTool(tool: any): boolean
	if not tool or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false
	end

	-- 1. Identificación autoritativa explícita: debe haber sido creada y sellada por GiveSlap
	if tool:GetAttribute("IsSlapWeapon") ~= true then
		return false
	end

	-- 2. Validación estructural complementaria del contenedor de combate
	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	if not config or not config:FindFirstChild("Power") then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

export type PlayerLockData = {
	slapName: string,
	playerConnections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	charConnections: { RBXScriptConnection },
	isEnforcing: boolean,
	currentTool: Tool?,
}

SlapService._playerLocks = {} :: { [Player]: PlayerLockData }

-- Clona un Slap desde ServerStorage.Slaps, lo entrega al jugador y lo equipa automáticamente
function SlapService:GiveSlap(player: Player, slapName: string?): Tool?
	local targetName = slapName or "Classic"
	local template = self:GetSlapTemplate(targetName)
	if not template then
		-- Fallback a Classic si el solicitado no existe
		template = self:GetSlapTemplate("Classic")
	end
	if not template then
		warn(string.format("[SlapService] No se encontro plantilla de Slap para '%s'", tostring(targetName)))
		return nil
	end

	-- Limpiar cualquier Slap previo para evitar acumulacion
	self:RemoveSlaps(player)

	local clone = template:Clone()
	clone.Name = template.Name
	clone.CanBeDropped = false
	clone:SetAttribute("IsSlapWeapon", true)
	clone:SetAttribute("SlapName", template.Name)

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local char = player.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if backpack then
		clone.Parent = backpack
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and char and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:EquipTool(clone)
			end)
		end
	elseif char then
		clone.Parent = char
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:EquipTool(clone)
			end)
		end
	else
		clone:Destroy()
		return nil
	end

	-- Si el jugador tiene un lock activo, actualizar la referencia a la nueva herramienta
	local lock = self._playerLocks[player]
	if lock then
		lock.currentTool = clone
	end

	return clone
end

-- Remueve todos los Slap tools del Backpack y Character del jugador
function SlapService:RemoveSlaps(player: Player)
	if not player then return end

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, child in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	-- Restaurar cualquier herramienta ajena preservada en Player hacia Backpack
	if backpack then
		for _, child in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				if self:IsSlapTool(child) then
					child:Destroy()
				else
					child.Parent = backpack
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Bloquea autoritativamente el equipamiento del jugador para que no pueda desequipar ni cambiar de herramienta
function SlapService:LockAndEquipPlayer(player: Player, slapName: string?)
	if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
		return
	end

	self:UnlockPlayer(player)

	local lockData: PlayerLockData = {
		slapName = slapName or "Classic",
		playerConnections = {},
		charConnections = {},
		isEnforcing = false,
		currentTool = nil,
	}
	self._playerLocks[player] = lockData

	local function enforceEquipped()
		if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData then return end
		if lockData.isEnforcing then return end

		local char = player.Character
		if not char or not char.Parent or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

		local tool = lockData.currentTool

		-- Detectar si hay alguna herramienta no autorizada en Character
		local hasForeignTool = false
		for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and item ~= tool then
				hasForeignTool = true
				break
			end
		end

		if tool and tool.Parent == char and not hasForeignTool then
			return
		end

		lockData.isEnforcing = true
			local generation = char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0
			local matchId = player:GetAttribute("MatchId")
			local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
			local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
			local version = session and session.StateVersion
			local function currentCharacter(): boolean
				return player.Parent == Players and player.Character == char and char.Parent ~= nil
					and (char:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) == generation
					and not char:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending")
					and player:GetAttribute("MatchId") == matchId
					and player:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") == nil
					and (session == nil or (rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player) == session
						and session.StateVersion == version and rounds:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
						and not session.Closing and not session.Closed and not session.Cancelled and not session.GameplayFrozen))
			end
		task.defer(function()
			-- Verificación estricta de identidad de bloqueo
				if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not currentCharacter() then
				lockData.isEnforcing = false
				return
			end

			local success, err = pcall(function()
					local c = char
				local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if c and c.Parent and c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h and h.Health > 0 then
					local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
					if not backpack then
						backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 0.5) :: Backpack?
						-- Validación estricta post-yield si WaitForChild cedió el hilo
							if self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not currentCharacter() or not c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
							return
						end
					end

					local t = lockData.currentTool

					-- Si backpack está disponible, devolver herramientas ajenas preservadas en Player
					if backpack then
						for _, child in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do
							if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= t then
								if not self:IsSlapTool(child) then
									child.Parent = backpack
								else
									child:Destroy()
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- 1. Desalojar cualquier herramienta ajena del Character hacia el Backpack
					for _, item in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
						if item:IsA("Tool") and item ~= t then
							if backpack then
								item.Parent = backpack
							else
								-- Conservar la herramienta ajena sin destruirla; alojarla en Player temporalmente
								if self:IsSlapTool(item) then
									item:Destroy()
								else
									pcall(function()
										item.Parent = player
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- 2. Asegurar que el Slap esté equipado en la mano
					if t and t.Parent == backpack then
						pcall(function()
							h:EquipTool(t)
						end)
					elseif not t or not t:IsDescendantOf(player) or not self:IsSlapTool(t) then
						-- Si el Slap no existe o fue destruido, regenerar y equipar
						local newTool = self:GiveSlap(player, lockData.slapName)
						lockData.currentTool = newTool
						if newTool then
							pcall(function()
								h:EquipTool(newTool)
							end)
						end
					elseif t.Parent ~= c then
						pcall(function()
							h:EquipTool(t)
						end)
					end
				end
			end)

			-- Garantizar que isEnforcing se restablezca siempre
			lockData.isEnforcing = false

			if not success and err then
				warn(string.format("[SlapService] Error durante enforceEquipped para '%s': %s", player.Name, tostring(err)))
			end
		end)
	end

	local function bindCharacter(char: Model)
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.charConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		table.clear(lockData.charConnections)

		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5) :: Humanoid?
		-- Validación estricta post-yield: si la partida terminó o el personaje/jugador ya no es válido, salir sin entregar Slap
		if not hum or self._playerLocks[player] ~= lockData or not char.Parent or not char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			return
		end

		-- Entregar y equipar Slap en este character
		local tool = self:GiveSlap(player, lockData.slapName)
		lockData.currentTool = tool
		if tool and hum.Health > 0 and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			pcall(function()
				hum:EquipTool(tool)
			end)
		end

		-- Escuchar cuando el Slap u otra cosa sale del Character (e.g. unequip)
		local charRemovedConn = char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
				enforceEquipped()
			end
		end)
		table.insert(lockData.charConnections, charRemovedConn)

		-- Escuchar cuando otra herramienta es equipada en el Character
		local charAddedConn = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and child ~= lockData.currentTool and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
				enforceEquipped()
			end
		end)
		table.insert(lockData.charConnections, charAddedConn)

		-- Escuchar cuando una herramienta entra al Backpack (cuando el cliente la desequipa)
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			local bpConn = backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
				if child:IsA("Tool") and self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
					enforceEquipped()
				end
			end)
			table.insert(lockData.charConnections, bpConn)
		end
	end

	-- Escuchar si el personaje muere y reaparece (respawn durante partida)
	local charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar: Model)
		if self._playerLocks[player] == lockData then
			bindCharacter(newChar)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(lockData.playerConnections, charAddedConn)

	-- Si el personaje ya existe actualmente en Workspace
	if player.Character and player.Character.Parent and player.Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		bindCharacter(player.Character)
	end
end

-- Desbloquea el equipamiento del jugador y limpia todas las conexiones
function SlapService:UnlockPlayer(player: Player)
	local lockData = self._playerLocks[player]
	if lockData then
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.playerConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		for _, c in ipairs(lockData.charConnections) do
			if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
		end
		self._playerLocks[player] = nil
	end
end

function SlapService:IsPlayerLocked(player: Player): boolean
	return self._playerLocks[player] ~= nil
end

-- Entrega y bloquea los Slaps a todos los contendientes de una partida
function SlapService:EquipMatchPlayers(session: MatchSession, slapName: string?)
	if not session then return end

	local participants: { Player } = {}
	if session.RedTeam and #session.RedTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.RedTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.RedPlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.RedPlayer)
	end
	if session.BlueTeam and #session.BlueTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.BlueTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.BluePlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.BluePlayer)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		self:LockAndEquipPlayer(player, slapName)
	end
end

-- Retira el bloqueo y los Slaps de todos los contendientes de una partida
function SlapService:RemoveMatchPlayers(session: MatchSession)
	if not session then return end

	local participants: { Player } = {}
	if session.RedTeam and #session.RedTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.RedTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.RedPlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.RedPlayer)
	end
	if session.BlueTeam and #session.BlueTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.BlueTeam) do table.insert(participants, p) end
	elseif session.BluePlayer then
		table.insert(participants, session.BluePlayer)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		self:UnlockPlayer(player)
		self:RemoveSlaps(player)
	end
end

-- Valida que la herramienta sea un Slap autorizado con Configuration valida
function SlapService:_validateTool(player: Player, tool: any): (boolean, number, number, string?)
	if not tool or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidToolInstance"
	end

	-- Debe ser un Slap legítimo administrado por SlapService
	if not self:IsSlapTool(tool) then
		return false, 0, 0, "NotAuthorizedSlap"
	end

	-- Debe estar equipada en el Character activo del jugador
	local char = player.Character
	if not char or tool.Parent ~= char then
		return false, 0, 0, "ToolNotEquipped"
	end

	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	if not config then
		return false, 0, 0, "MissingConfiguration"
	end

	local powerVal = config:FindFirstChild("Power")
	if not powerVal or not powerVal:IsA("NumberValue") or powerVal.Value <= 0 then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidPowerValue"
	end

	local cooldownVal = config:FindFirstChild("SlapCooldown")
	if not cooldownVal or not cooldownVal:IsA("NumberValue") or cooldownVal.Value < 0 then
		return false, 0, 0, "InvalidCooldownValue"
	end

	return true, powerVal.Value, cooldownVal.Value, nil
end

local function isPlayer(p: any): boolean
	if not p then return false end
	if typeof(p) == "Instance" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	if (typeof(p) == "userdata" or typeof(p) == "table") and type(p.IsA) == "function" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	return false
end

-- Selecciona como máximo un oponente usando exclusivamente el registro
-- autoritativo de la sesión. Prioridad: menor distancia, luego Slot y UserId.
function SlapService:_selectOpponent(
	attacker: Player,
	session: MatchSession,
	attackerRoot: BasePart
): (Player?, BasePart?, Vector3?, string?)
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService
		or type(roundService.GetSessionParticipant) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.GetSessionForPlayer) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.GetSessionById) ~= "function"
		or type(roundService.IsSessionActive) ~= "function"
		or roundService:GetSessionById(session.Id) ~= session
		or not roundService:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
		or session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing
		or session.Closing or session.Cancelled or session.Closed then
		return nil, nil, nil, "SessionNotCombatReady"
	end

	local attackerParticipant = roundService:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, attacker)
	if not attackerParticipant then return nil, nil, nil, "AttackerNotParticipant" end

	local selected: Player? = nil
	local selectedRoot: BasePart? = nil
	local selectedDiff: Vector3? = nil
	local selectedDistance = math.huge
	local selectedSlot = math.huge
	local selectedUserId = math.huge
	local firstRejection: string? = nil
	local forwardDir = attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector

	for _, rosterParticipant in ipairs(session.Participants) do
		if rosterParticipant.Team == attackerParticipant.Team
			or rosterParticipant.State == "Left"
			or rosterParticipant.State == "Released" then
			continue
		end

		local candidate = rosterParticipant.Player
		if not isPlayer(candidate) or candidate == attacker or candidate.Parent ~= Players then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "InvalidOpponent"
			continue
		end
		if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(candidate) ~= session
			or roundService:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, candidate) ~= rosterParticipant then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "DifferentMatch"
			continue
		end

		local character = candidate.Character
			if character and character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then
				firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimRespawning"
				continue
			end
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not root then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimNotSpawned"
			continue
		end
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "VictimNotAlive"
			continue
		end

		local diff = root.Position - attackerRoot.Position
		local distance = diff.Magnitude
		if distance > MAX_SLAP_REACH then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "OutOfReach"
			continue
		end
		local direction = if distance > 0.05 then diff.Unit else forwardDir
		if forwardDir:Dot(direction) < MIN_FACING_DOT then
			firstRejection = firstRejection or "TargetBehindAttacker"
			continue
		end

		local slot = rosterParticipant.Slot
		local userId = rosterParticipant.UserId
		if distance < selectedDistance
			or (distance == selectedDistance and slot < selectedSlot)
			or (distance == selectedDistance and slot == selectedSlot and userId < selectedUserId) then
			selected = candidate
			selectedRoot = root
			selectedDiff = diff
			selectedDistance = distance
			selectedSlot = slot
			selectedUserId = userId
		end
	end

	return selected, selectedRoot, selectedDiff, if selected then nil else (firstRejection or "NoValidOpponent")
end

-- Ejecuta la resolucion autoritativa del golpe
function SlapService:ProcessSlap(attacker: Player, tool: Tool): (boolean, string?)
	-- 1. Validar que el atacante sea un Player valido
	if not isPlayer(attacker) or not attacker.Parent then
		return false, "InvalidAttacker"
	end

	local attackerChar = attacker.Character
	if attackerChar and attackerChar:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false, "AttackerRespawning" end
	if not attackerChar or not attackerChar:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false, "AttackerCharNotSpawned"
	end

	local attackerHumanoid = attackerChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local attackerRoot = attackerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not attackerHumanoid or attackerHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not attackerRoot then
		return false, "AttackerNotAlive"
	end

	-- 2. Validar que la herramienta sea un Slap valido y este equipada
	local okTool, power, cooldown, toolErr = self:_validateTool(attacker, tool)
	if not okTool then
		return false, toolErr or "ToolValidationFailed"
	end

	-- 3. Validar estado de la partida (solo en estado PLAYING)
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService then
		return false, "RoundServiceUnavailable"
	end

	local session = roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(attacker)
	if not session then
		return false, "NotInMatch"
	end

	if session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then
		return false, "MatchNotPlaying"
	end

	-- 4. Validar cooldown del servidor
	local now = os.clock()
	local nextAllowed = self._cooldowns[attacker] or 0
	if now < nextAllowed then
		return false, "OnCooldown"
	end
	self._cooldowns[attacker] = now + cooldown

	-- 5-6. Resolver un único objetivo rival y aplicar las validaciones espaciales existentes.
	local opponent, victimRoot, diff, targetReason = self:_selectOpponent(attacker, session, attackerRoot)
	if not opponent or not victimRoot or not diff then
		return false, targetReason or "NoValidOpponent"
	end
	local victimChar = opponent.Character :: Model
	local forwardDir = attackerRoot.CFrame.LookVector

	-- 7. Registrar impacto autoritativo en CombatService
	local combatService = self:_getCombatService()
	if not combatService then
		return false, "CombatServiceUnavailable"
	end

	local hitSuccess, hitReason = combatService:RegisterHit(attacker, opponent, session.Id)
	if not hitSuccess then
		return false, hitReason or "CombatServiceRejected"
	end

	-- 8. Reproducir feedback sonoro de impacto
	local hand = tool:FindFirstChild("Hand")
	local hitSound = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("Hit") :: Sound?
	if hitSound and hitSound:IsA("Sound") then
		pcall(function()
			hitSound:Play()
		end)
	end

	-- 9. Aplicar knockback y ragdoll autoritativo via RagdollService
	local ragdollService = self:_getRagdollService()
	if ragdollService then
		local horizDiff = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)
		local horizDir = if horizDiff.Magnitude > 0.1 then horizDiff.Unit else forwardDir

		local upwardRatio = 0.35
		local vertSpeed = math.max(power * upwardRatio * 1.3, 26)
		local horizSpeed = power * (1 - upwardRatio * 0.2)
		local launchVelocity = horizDir * horizSpeed + Vector3.new(0, vertSpeed, 0)

		ragdollService:ApplyRagdoll(victimChar, DEFAULT_RAGDOLL_DURATION, launchVelocity)
	end

	print(string.format("[SlapService] Slap exitoso: '%s' golpeo a '%s' con '%s' (Power=%d, Cooldown=%.2f)",
		attacker.Name, opponent.Name, tool.Name, power, cooldown))

	return true, nil
end

-- RagdollService
-- Servicio central para el ciclo de vida de Ragdoll y física de impacto/lanzamiento.
-- Coordina ReplicatedStorage.StateEvent y StarterCharacterScripts.RagdollStatesHandler.
-- Soporta avatares R15 modernos (AnimationConstraint + BallSocketConstraint) y R6 clásicos (Motor6D).
-- Diseñado para la onda expansiva del Point Effect y para el futuro sistema de combate/slap.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

RagdollService._activeTimers = {} :: { [Model]: thread }
RagdollService._r6Instances = {} :: { [Model]: { Instance } }
RagdollService._rootCollisions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: { [Model]: boolean }

function RagdollService:_getStateEvent(): UnreliableRemoteEvent?

	if evt and evt:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
		return evt
	elseif evt and evt:IsA("RemoteEvent") then

-- Retorna true si el personaje se encuentra actualmente en estado Ragdoll
