end

-- Pasa el personaje a estado Ragdoll físico y notifica a RagdollStatesHandler
function RagdollService:ApplyRagdoll(character: Model, duration: number?, launchVelocity: Vector3?): boolean
	if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return false end
	if character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false end
	local owner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if owner and owner:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") ~= nil then return false end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not rootPart then return false end
	if self._rootCollisions[character] == nil then self._rootCollisions[character] = rootPart.CanCollide end

	-- Cancelar timer previo si ya estaba en ragdoll
	local prevTimer = self._activeTimers[character]
	if prevTimer then
		pcall(task.cancel, prevTimer)
		self._activeTimers[character] = nil
	end

	local hasAnimationConstraints = false
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and desc.Name ~= "Root" then
			hasAnimationConstraints = true
			desc.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	-- Si es R6 clásico (no usa AnimationConstraint sino Motor6D)
	-- Repeated hits refresh velocity/timer, not the physical rig. Replacing this
	-- list leaked the first hit's constraints/colliders beyond ResetRagdollImmediate.
	if not hasAnimationConstraints and not self._r6Instances[character] then
		local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") :: BasePart?
		local rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") :: Motor6D?
		if torso and rootJoint then
			rootPart.Massless = true
			local instances = {}

			if not rootPart:FindFirstChild("TorsoWeld") then
				local torsoWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				torsoWeld.Part0 = rootPart
				torsoWeld.Part1 = torso
				torsoWeld.Name = "TorsoWeld"
				torsoWeld.Parent = rootPart
				table.insert(instances, torsoWeld)
			end
			rootJoint.Enabled = false

			for _, v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if v:IsA("Motor6D") and v ~= rootJoint then
					local part0, part1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
					if part0 and part1 then
						local collider = Instance.new("Part")
						collider.Size = part1.Size / 1.7
						collider.CFrame = part1.CFrame
						collider.Massless = true
						collider.CanQuery = false
						collider.CollisionGroup = part1.CollisionGroup
						collider.CanTouch = false
						collider.Transparency = 1
						collider.Name = "Collider"
						collider.Parent = part1
						table.insert(instances, collider)

						local colliderWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
						colliderWeld.Part0 = collider
						colliderWeld.Part1 = part1
						colliderWeld.Parent = collider
						table.insert(instances, colliderWeld)

						local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
						attachment0.CFrame = v.C0
						attachment0.Name = part1.Name .. "_RagdollAttachment0"
						attachment0.Parent = part0
						table.insert(instances, attachment0)

						local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
						attachment1.CFrame = v.C1
						attachment1.Name = "RagdollAttachment1"
						attachment1.Parent = part1
						table.insert(instances, attachment1)

						local ballSocket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
						ballSocket.Attachment0 = attachment0
						ballSocket.Attachment1 = attachment1
						ballSocket.LimitsEnabled = true
						ballSocket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
						ballSocket.Name = "RagdollConstraint"
						ballSocket.Parent = part1
						table.insert(instances, ballSocket)

						v.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
			self._r6Instances[character] = instances
		end
	end

	-- Configuración del Humanoid
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	rootPart.CanCollide = false

	-- Aplicar velocidad en el servidor si se provee a todas las partes
	if launchVelocity then
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launchVelocity
				part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
					math.random(-6, 6),
					math.random(-6, 6),
					math.random(-6, 6)
				)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Notificar al cliente mediante StateEvent para activar RagdollStatesHandler
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local stateEvent = self:_getStateEvent()
	if player and stateEvent then
		stateEvent:FireClient(player, false, launchVelocity, player:GetAttribute("MatchId"), character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0, character)
	else
		pcall(function()
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
		end)
	end

	-- Programar recuperación automática
	local ragDuration = duration or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.DefaultDuration) or 2.0
	if ragDuration > 0 then
		local generation = character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0
		local sessionId = player and player:GetAttribute("MatchId")
		local rounds = self._context and self._context:GetService("RoundService")
		local session = player and rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
		local stateVersion = session and session.StateVersion
		local recovery: thread
		recovery = task.delay(ragDuration, function()
			local stale = self._activeTimers[character] ~= recovery or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
				or (character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) ~= generation
				or character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") == true
				or (player ~= nil and (player.Parent ~= Players or player.Character ~= character
					or player:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= sessionId or player:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") ~= nil))
				or (session ~= nil and (rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player) ~= session
					or session.StateVersion ~= stateVersion or not rounds:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
					or session.Closing or session.Closed or session.Cancelled or session.GameplayFrozen))
			if stale then
				if self._activeTimers[character] == recovery then self._activeTimers[character] = nil end
				if Config.Respawn.Debug then warn("[RespawnDebug] StaleRagdollRecovery", player and player.UserId, generation, character:GetAttribute("ArenaEliminationId")) end
				return
			end
			self._activeTimers[character] = nil
			self:RemoveRagdoll(character)
		end)
		self._activeTimers[character] = recovery
	end

	return true
end

-- Restaura el personaje a su estado normal de locomoción notificando a RagdollStatesHandler
function RagdollService:RemoveRagdoll(character: Model): boolean
	if character and character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return false end
	local timer = self._activeTimers[character]
	if timer then
		pcall(task.cancel, timer)
		self._activeTimers[character] = nil
	end

	if not character or not character.Parent then return false end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

	-- 1. Reactivar AnimationConstraints si es R15
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
			desc.Enabled = true
		end
	end

	-- 2. Limpiar R6 si correspondía
	local r6Instances = self._r6Instances[character]
	if r6Instances then
		if rootPart then rootPart.Massless = false end
		for _, v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
				v.Enabled = true
			end
		end
		for _, inst in ipairs(r6Instances) do
			if inst and inst.Parent then
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		end
		self._r6Instances[character] = nil
	end

	-- 3. Restaurar Humanoid y colisión del RootPart
	if rootPart then
		local original = self._rootCollisions[character]
		if original ~= nil then rootPart.CanCollide = original end
		self._rootCollisions[character] = nil
	end

	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local stateEvent = self:_getStateEvent()
		if player and stateEvent then
			stateEvent:FireClient(player, true, nil, player:GetAttribute("MatchId"), character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0, character)
		else
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
			end)
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Reseteo forzado e inmediato de ragdoll para reposicionamiento en arena (Zero-Death)
-- Idempotente, síncrono, cancela timers/callbacks y restaura articulaciones, colisiones y estado físico.
function RagdollService:ResetRagdollImmediate(character: Model, quietRespawn: boolean?): boolean
	if not character or not character.Parent then return false end

	-- 1. Cancelar cualquier timer pendiente para evitar callbacks diferidos
	local timer = self._activeTimers[character]
	if timer then
		pcall(task.cancel, timer)
		self._activeTimers[character] = nil
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

	-- 2. Reactivar AnimationConstraints si es R15
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
			desc.Enabled = true
		end
	end

	-- 3. Limpiar instancias R6 si correspondía
	local r6Instances = self._r6Instances[character]
	if r6Instances then
		if rootPart then rootPart.Massless = false end
		for _, v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
				v.Enabled = true
			end
		end
		for _, inst in ipairs(r6Instances) do
			if inst and inst.Parent then
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		end
		self._r6Instances[character] = nil
	end

	-- 4. Anular colapso de RootJoint / TorsoWeld residuales si existieran
	if rootPart then
		rootPart.Massless = false
		local original = self._rootCollisions[character]
		if original ~= nil then rootPart.CanCollide = original end
		self._rootCollisions[character] = nil
		local rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") :: Motor6D?
		if rootJoint then
			rootJoint.Enabled = true
		end
		local torsoWeld = rootPart:FindFirstChild("TorsoWeld")
		if torsoWeld then
			torsoWeld:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Quiet Zero-Death recovery runs with the root anchored by ArenaRespawn.
	-- Reassemble R6 at rest BEFORE teleport/collision restoration; enabling motors
	-- alone leaves ragdoll limb poses for the next solver step to correct.
	if quietRespawn and r6Instances and rootPart and rootPart.Anchored then
		local motors: { Motor6D } = {}
		for _, joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
				joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
				table.insert(motors, joint)
			end
		end
		local positioned: { [BasePart]: boolean } = { [rootPart] = true }
		for _ = 1, #motors do
			local progressed = false
			for _, joint in ipairs(motors) do
				local a, b = joint.Part0, joint.Part1
				if a and b and positioned[a] and not positioned[b] then
					b.CFrame = a.CFrame * joint.C0 * joint.C1:Inverse()
					positioned[b] = true
					progressed = true
				end
			end
			if not progressed then break end
		end
	end

	-- 5. Restaurar estado de locomoción en Humanoid sin alterar Health
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local stateEvent = self:_getStateEvent()
		if player and stateEvent and not quietRespawn then
			stateEvent:FireClient(player, true, nil, player:GetAttribute("MatchId"), character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0, character)
		end

		pcall(function()
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
			if quietRespawn then humanoid.Jump = false end
			humanoid:ChangeState(if quietRespawn then Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running else Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		end)
	end

	-- 6. Anular cualquier inercia o impulso en todas las partes del modelo
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			desc.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Calcula el vector tridimensional de impulso de lanzamiento a partir de un punto de origen
function RagdollService:ComputeLaunchVelocity(
	originPos: Vector3,
	targetPos: Vector3,
	forceMagnitude: number?,
	upwardRatio: number?
): Vector3
	local force = forceMagnitude or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.BlastForce) or 110
	local upRatio = upwardRatio or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.UpwardRatio) or 0.65
	upRatio = math.clamp(upRatio, 0.2, 0.9)

	local diff = targetPos - originPos
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(diff.X, 0, diff.Z)
	local horizDist = horizontal.Magnitude

	local horizDir: Vector3
	if horizDist > 0.5 then
		horizDir = horizontal.Unit
	else
		-- Directamente en el epicentro: dispersar en dirección horizontal aleatoria
		local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
		horizDir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
	end

	-- Componente vertical fuerte y garantizado para elevar al personaje por los aires (vence gravedad 196.2)
	local vertSpeed = math.max(force * upRatio * 1.3, 85)
	local horizSpeed = force * (1 - upRatio * 0.4)

	return horizDir * horizSpeed + Vector3.new(0, vertSpeed, 0)
end

-- Aplica un impulso físico de lanzamiento al personaje alejándolo de un punto de origen
function RagdollService:LaunchCharacter(character: Model, originPos: Vector3, forceMagnitude: number?, upwardRatio: number?)
	if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
	if character:GetAttribute("ArenaRespawnPending") then return end
	local owner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if owner and owner:GetAttribute("ResultsSessionId") ~= nil then return end

	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? or character.PrimaryPart
	if not rootPart then return end

	local launchVel = self:ComputeLaunchVelocity(originPos, rootPart.Position, forceMagnitude, upwardRatio)

	-- Asignar velocidad lineal y rotacional en el servidor a todas las partes del cuerpo
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launchVel
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
				math.random(-6, 6),
				math.random(-6, 6),
				math.random(-6, 6)
			)
		end
	end

	-- Notificar al cliente para que su simulación local replique el lanzamiento
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local stateEvent = self:_getStateEvent()
	if player and stateEvent then
		stateEvent:FireClient(player, false, launchVel, player:GetAttribute("MatchId"), character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0, character)
	end
end

-- Detona una onda expansiva en originPos, enviando en ragdoll y por los aires a todos los personajes dentro del radio
function RagdollService:BlastZone(
	originPos: Vector3,
	radius: number?,
	forceMagnitude: number?,
	upwardRatio: number?,
	duration: number?,
	filterFunc: ((Player?, Model) -> boolean)?
): number
	local blastRadius = radius or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.BlastRadius) or 25
	local blastForce = forceMagnitude or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.BlastForce) or 110
	local upRatio = upwardRatio or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.UpwardRatio) or 0.65
	local ragDuration = duration or (Config.Ragdoll and Config.Ragdoll.DefaultDuration) or 2.0

	local affectedCount = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char and char:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
			local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if root then
				local dist = (root.Position - originPos).Magnitude
				if dist <= blastRadius then
					local allowed = true
					if filterFunc then
						allowed = filterFunc(player, char)
					end
					if allowed then
						local falloff = math.clamp(1 - (dist / blastRadius) * 0.35, 0.65, 1.0)
						local force = blastForce * falloff
						local launchVel = self:ComputeLaunchVelocity(originPos, root.Position, force, upRatio)

						self:ApplyRagdoll(char, ragDuration, launchVel)
						affectedCount += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return affectedCount
end

function RagdollService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._activeTimers = {}
	self._r6Instances = {}
	self._rootCollisions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
end

function RagdollService:Start(context)
	self._context = context
	print("[RagdollService] Servicio de Ragdoll activo, integrado con ReplicatedStorage.StateEvent y RagdollStatesHandler")
end

return RagdollService

		if type(teams) == "table" then
			self._currentRole = teams[localPlayer.UserId]
		end
	elseif self._currentMatchId ~= sessionId then
		return false
	end

	if version ~= nil and version < self._lastStateVersion then
		return false
	end
	if advanceVersion and version ~= nil then
		self._lastStateVersion = version
	end
	return true
end

	self._currentMatchId = nil
	self._lastStateVersion = 0
end

function MatchController:_connectRemotes()
	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
	if not remotesFolder then return end

	local matchFolder = remotesFolder:WaitForChild("Match", 10)
	if not matchFolder then return end

	local stateChanged = matchFolder:WaitForChild("StateChanged", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local countdown = matchFolder:WaitForChild("Countdown", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local mapSelection = matchFolder:WaitForChild("MapSelection", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local matchResult = matchFolder:WaitForChild("MatchResult", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local scoreUpdated = matchFolder:WaitForChild("ScoreUpdated", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local lastPoint = matchFolder:WaitForChild("LastPoint", 10) :: RemoteEvent?

	if stateChanged then
		stateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(newState: string, extraData: any)
			self:_handleStateChanged(newState, extraData)
		end)
	end

	if countdown then
		countdown.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(remaining: number, label: string, extraData: any?)
			self:_handleCountdown(remaining, label, extraData)
		end)
	end

	if mapSelection then
		mapSelection.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data: any)
			if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(data, false, false) then return end
			if type(data) == "table" and data.Maps then
				self:_populateMapSelection(data.Maps)
			elseif type(data) == "table" and data.Voted then
				self:_highlightSelectedVote(data.Voted)
			end
		end)
	end

	if matchResult then
		matchResult.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result: string, winnerName: string?, metadata: any)
			if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(metadata, false, false) then return end
			self:_handleMatchResult(result, winnerName)
		end)
	end

	if scoreUpdated then
		scoreUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data: any)
			if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(data, false, false) then return end
			self:_handleScoreUpdated(data)
		end)
	end

	if lastPoint then
		lastPoint.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data: any)
			if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(data, false, false) then return end
			self:_handleLastPoint(data)
		end)
	end

	local pointFeedback = matchFolder:WaitForChild("PointFeedback", 5) :: RemoteEvent?
	if pointFeedback then
		pointFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data: any)
			if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(data, false, false) then return end
			self:_handlePointFeedback(data)
		end)
	end
end

function MatchController:_handlePointFeedback(data: any)
	-- Hook arquitectónico preparado para Camera Shake y efectos de pantalla
	-- Autoridad exclusiva del servidor: el cliente reacciona pero no decide
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.IsFinalPoint == true then
		local musicController = self._context and self._context:GetController("MusicController")
		if musicController and typeof(musicController.Suspend) == "function" then
			local endCinematicConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.EndCinematicConfig)
			local fadeOut = (endCinematicConfig.Music and endCinematicConfig.Music.FadeOutDuration) or 0.4
			musicController:Suspend("EndCinematic", fadeOut)
		end
	end
	print(string.format("[MatchController] PointFeedback recibido del servidor: Equipo=%s, Jugador=%s, Efecto=%s, Final=%s",
		tostring(data.ScoringTeam),
		tostring(data.ScoringPlayerName),
		tostring(data.EffectId),
		tostring(data.IsFinalPoint)))
end

function MatchController:_handleStateChanged(newState: string, extraData: any)
	if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(extraData, true, true) then return end
	local eventSessionId = self._currentMatchId :: string
	local prevState = self._currentState
	self._currentState = newState
	print(string.format("[MatchController] Estado recibido: %s", newState))

	local isPointRestart = (newState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown)

	-- Ocultar frames condicionalmente (durante PointRestartCountdown el HUD y timer permanecen visibles)
	if not isPointRestart then
		if self._startCountdownFrame then self._startCountdownFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._countdownFrame and newState ~= Constants.RoundState.MatchReady and newState ~= Constants.RoundState.MatchCountdown then
			self._countdownFrame.Visible = false
		end
		if self._mapSelectionFrame then self._mapSelectionFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._matchTimerFrame and newState ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing then self._matchTimerFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._resultFrame then self._resultFrame.Visible = false end
	end

	if newState == Constants.RoundState.MatchReady then
		if extraData and extraData.MatchId then
			self._currentMatchId = extraData.MatchId
		end
		if extraData and extraData.Red and extraData.Blue then
			if extraData.Red == localPlayer.Name then
				self._currentRole = "Red"
			elseif extraData.Blue == localPlayer.Name then
				self._currentRole = "Blue"
			else
				self._currentRole = nil
			end
		end
		if self._countdownFrame then
			if self._countdownTitle then
				self._countdownTitle.Text = "LA PARTIDA COMIENZA EN"
			end
			if self._countdownTimer then
				local defaultDuration = Config.Round and Config.Round.MatchCountdownTime or 5
				self._countdownTimer.Text = tostring(defaultDuration)
			end
			self._countdownFrame.Visible = true
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.MatchCountdown then
		if self._countdownFrame then
			if self._countdownTitle then
				self._countdownTitle.Text = "LA PARTIDA COMIENZA EN"
			end
			if extraData and extraData.Duration and self._countdownTimer then
				self._countdownTimer.Text = tostring(extraData.Duration)
			end
			self._countdownFrame.Visible = true
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.MapSelection then
		if self._mapSelectionFrame then
			self._selectedMapVote = nil
			self:_resetButtonHighlights()
			self._mapSelectionFrame.Visible = true
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.MapLoading then
		self._currentSelectedMap = extraData and extraData.SelectedMap
		if self._countdownFrame and self._countdownTitle and self._countdownTimer then
			self._countdownTitle.Text = "CARGANDO MAPA"
			self._countdownTimer.Text = extraData and extraData.SelectedMap or "..."
			self._countdownFrame.Visible = true
		end
		if self:IsParticipant() then
			local musicController = self._context and self._context:GetController("MusicController")
			if musicController then
				musicController:PlayArena(self._currentSelectedMap or "Default")
			end
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown then
		if extraData and extraData.MatchId then
			self._currentMatchId = extraData.MatchId
		end
		if extraData and extraData.SelectedMap and not self._currentSelectedMap then
			self._currentSelectedMap = extraData.SelectedMap
		end
		if self:IsParticipant() then
			local musicController = self._context and self._context:GetController("MusicController")
			if musicController and musicController:GetCurrentState() ~= "Arena" then
				musicController:PlayArena(self._currentSelectedMap or "Default")
			end
		end
		if self._startCountdownFrame then
			if self._startCountdownTitle then
				self._startCountdownTitle.Text = "LA PARTIDA COMIENZA"
			end
			if self._startCountdownLabel then
				local duration = (extraData and extraData.Duration) or 5
				self._startCountdownLabel.Text = tostring(duration)
			end
			self._startCountdownFrame.Visible = true
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown then
		if extraData and extraData.MatchId then
			self._currentMatchId = extraData.MatchId
		end
		if self._startCountdownFrame then
			if self._startCountdownTitle then
				self._startCountdownTitle.Text = "SIGUIENTE PUNTO EN"
			end
			if self._startCountdownLabel then
				local duration = (extraData and extraData.Duration) or 3
				self._startCountdownLabel.Text = tostring(duration)
			end
			self._startCountdownFrame.Visible = true
		end
		if self._matchTimerFrame then self._matchTimerFrame.Visible = true end
		if self._redTeamFrame then self._redTeamFrame.Visible = true end
		if self._blueTeamFrame then self._blueTeamFrame.Visible = true end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.Playing then
		if extraData and extraData.MatchId then
			self._currentMatchId = extraData.MatchId
		end
		if self._startCountdownFrame then
			self._startCountdownFrame.Visible = false
		end
		if self._matchTimerFrame then
			self._matchTimerFrame.Visible = true
		end
		if self._redTeamFrame then
			self._redTeamFrame.Visible = true
		end
		if self._blueTeamFrame then
			self._blueTeamFrame.Visible = true
		end

		-- Solo inicializar score a 0 al inicio formal de la partida (no tras un punto anotado)
		if prevState == Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown or prevState == Constants.RoundState.MapLoading then
			if self._redScoreLabel then
				self._redScoreLabel.Text = "0"
			end
			if self._blueScoreLabel then
				self._blueScoreLabel.Text = "0"
			end
		end

		self:_populatePlayers(
			extraData and extraData.RedTeam,
			extraData and extraData.BlueTeam,
			extraData and extraData.Red,
			extraData and extraData.Blue
		)

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.Ending then
		if self._resultFrame then
			self._resultFrame.Visible = not (extraData and extraData.Cinematic == true)
		end
		if self._lastPointFrame then
			self._lastPointFrame.Visible = false
		end
		local musicController = self._context and self._context:GetController("MusicController")
		if musicController and typeof(musicController.Suspend) == "function" then
			local endCinematicConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.EndCinematicConfig)
			local fadeOut = (endCinematicConfig.Music and endCinematicConfig.Music.FadeOutDuration) or 0.4
			musicController:Suspend("EndCinematic", fadeOut)
		end

	elseif newState == Constants.RoundState.ReturningToLobby or newState == Constants.RoundState.Waiting then
		local wasParticipant = self:IsParticipant()
		self._currentRole = nil
		self._selectedMapVote = nil
		self._currentSelectedMap = nil
		if self._countdownFrame then self._countdownFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._startCountdownFrame then self._startCountdownFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._redTeamFrame then self._redTeamFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._blueTeamFrame then self._blueTeamFrame.Visible = false end
		if self._lastPointFrame then self._lastPointFrame.Visible = false end
		self:_clearClonedButtons()
		self:_clearPlayerSlots()

		local musicController = self._context and self._context:GetController("MusicController")
		local endCinematic = self._context and self._context:GetController("EndCinematicController")
		if (not endCinematic or not endCinematic:IsPlaying()) and musicController and typeof(musicController.Resume) == "function" then
			musicController:Resume("EndCinematic")
		end

		if wasParticipant or newState == Constants.RoundState.ReturningToLobby then
			if musicController then
				musicController:PlayLobby()
			end
		end
		self:_clearSessionIdentity(eventSessionId)
		self._currentState = Constants.RoundState.Waiting
	end
end

function MatchController:_handleLastPoint(data: any)
	if not self._lastPointFrame or not self._lastPointTitle then return end
	local team = data and data.Team
	local message = data and data.Message or "ÚLTIMO PUNTO PARA GANAR LA PARTIDA"

	self._lastPointTitle.Text = message

	if self._lastPointSubtitle then
		if team == "Red" then
			self._lastPointSubtitle.Text = "¡EQUIPO ROJO A 1 PUNTO DE LA VICTORIA!"
			self._lastPointSubtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
		elseif team == "Blue" then
			self._lastPointSubtitle.Text = "¡EQUIPO AZUL A 1 PUNTO DE LA VICTORIA!"
			self._lastPointSubtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255)
		else
			self._lastPointSubtitle.Text = "¡A 1 punto de la victoria!"
			self._lastPointSubtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		end
	end

	self._lastPointFrame.Visible = true

	local token = os.clock()
	self._lastPointToken = token
	task.delay(4, function()
		if self._lastPointToken == token and self._lastPointFrame then
			self._lastPointFrame.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function MatchController:_clearPlayerSlots()
	for _, slot in ipairs(self._clonedSlots) do
		slot:Destroy()
	end
	self._clonedSlots = {}
end

function MatchController:_populatePlayers(redData: any, blueData: any, redFallback: string?, blueFallback: string?)
	self:_clearPlayerSlots()
	if not self._playerSlotTemplate then return end

	local createSlot = function(playerInfo: any, fallbackName: string?, container: Frame?, teamColor: Color3)
		if not container then return end
		local slot = self._playerSlotTemplate:Clone()
		local name = if type(playerInfo) == "table" and playerInfo.Name then playerInfo.Name else fallbackName or "Jugador"
		local displayName = if type(playerInfo) == "table" and playerInfo.DisplayName then playerInfo.DisplayName else name
		local userId = if type(playerInfo) == "table" and playerInfo.UserId then playerInfo.UserId else 0

		slot.Name = "Slot_" .. name
		local nameLabel = slot:FindFirstChild("DisplayName") :: TextLabel?
		if nameLabel then
			nameLabel.Text = displayName
		end

		local userLabel = slot:FindFirstChild("Username") :: TextLabel?
		if userLabel then
			userLabel.Text = "@" .. name
		end

		local avatarImg = slot:FindFirstChild("Avatar") :: ImageLabel?
		if avatarImg and userId > 0 then
			avatarImg.Image = string.format("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=100&h=100", userId)
		end

		local stroke = slot:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if stroke then
			stroke.Color = teamColor
		end

		slot.Visible = true
		slot.Parent = container
		table.insert(self._clonedSlots, slot)
	end

	-- Red team
	if type(redData) == "table" and #redData > 0 then
		for _, pInfo in ipairs(redData) do
			createSlot(pInfo, redFallback, self._redPlayersContainer, Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40))
		end
	else
		createSlot(nil, redFallback, self._redPlayersContainer, Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40))
	end

	-- Blue team
	if type(blueData) == "table" and #blueData > 0 then
		for _, pInfo in ipairs(blueData) do
			createSlot(pInfo, blueFallback, self._bluePlayersContainer, Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 160))
		end
	else
		createSlot(nil, blueFallback, self._bluePlayersContainer, Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 160))
	end
end

function MatchController:_handleCountdown(remaining: number, label: string, extraData: any?)
	if not self:_acceptSessionPayload(extraData, false, false) then return end

	if extraData and extraData.Cancelled then
		if self._countdownFrame then
			self._countdownFrame.Visible = false
		end
		return
	end

	if self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.MatchCountdown then
		if self._countdownTimer then
			self._countdownTimer.Text = tostring(remaining)
		end
	elseif self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.MapSelection then
		if self._mapTimer then
			self._mapTimer.Text = tostring(remaining)
		end
	elseif self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.StartCountdown
		or self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown
		or label == "START_COUNTDOWN" then
		self:_updateStartCountdown(remaining, extraData)
	elseif self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.Playing then
		if self._matchTimer then
			self._matchTimer.Text = formatTime(remaining)
		end
	end
end

-- ===== Utilidades matematicas =====

local function lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

local function clamp01(x: number): number
	return math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
end

local function easeOutCubic(x: number): number
	return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end

-- Bezier cubica y su derivada (tangente)
local function bezier3(p0: Vector2, p1: Vector2, p2: Vector2, p3: Vector2, t: number): Vector2
	local u = 1 - t
	return p0 * (u * u * u) + p1 * (3 * u * u * t) + p2 * (3 * u * t * t) + p3 * (t * t * t)
end

local function bezier3Tangent(p0: Vector2, p1: Vector2, p2: Vector2, p3: Vector2, t: number): Vector2
	local u = 1 - t
	return (p1 - p0) * (3 * u * u) + (p2 - p1) * (6 * u * t) + (p3 - p2) * (3 * t * t)
end

-- Resorte subamortiguado: vale 1 en t = 0 y decae a 0 oscilando (pasa por valores negativos = rebote)
local function springKick(t: number, freq: number, damping: number): number
	if t <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	local wd = freq * math.sqrt(1 - damping * damping)
	local decay = math.exp(-damping * freq * t)
	return decay * (math.cos(wd * t) + (damping * freq / wd) * math.sin(wd * t))
end

local function flightPoint(s: number): Vector2
	local c = COUNTDOWN
	return bezier3(c.StartPoint, c.ControlA, c.ControlB, c.EndPoint, s)
end

local function flightTilt(s: number): number
	local c = COUNTDOWN
	local tan = bezier3Tangent(c.StartPoint, c.ControlA, c.ControlB, c.EndPoint, s)
	return -tan.Unit.X * c.FlightTilt
end

local END_TILT = flightTilt(1)

-- ===== Poses (funciones puras del tiempo) =====

local function numberPose(t: number): Pose
	local c = COUNTDOWN
	local exitStart = c.EnterTime + c.SettleTime + c.HoldTime

	if t < c.EnterTime then
		local u = t / c.EnterTime
		local s = u ^ c.EnterEase
		local p = flightPoint(s)
		return {
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.X, p.Y),
			Rotation = flightTilt(s),
			Scale = lerp(c.FlightStartScale, 1 + c.ImpactScale, 1 - (1 - u) ^ 2),
			Transparency = 1 - clamp01(u / c.FadeInPortion),
			Depth = 1 + c.StretchDepth * u ^ 0.6,
			ShineY = 0,
		}
	end

	local ti = t - c.EnterTime
	local k = springKick(ti, c.SpringFreq, c.SpringDamping)
	local center = c.EndPoint
	local y = center.Y + c.ImpactSink * k
	local rot = END_TILT * k
	local scale = 1 + c.ImpactScale * k
	local depth = 1 - c.SquashDepth * k
	local shine = lerp(c.ShineStart, 0, easeOutCubic(clamp01(ti / c.ShineTime)))

	if t < exitStart then
		return {
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(center.X, y),
			Rotation = rot,
			Scale = scale,
			Transparency = 0,
			Depth = depth,
			ShineY = shine,
		}
	end

	local v = clamp01((t - exitStart) / c.ExitTime)
	local e = v * v
	return {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(center.X + c.ExitOffset.X * e, y + c.ExitOffset.Y * e),
		Rotation = lerp(rot, c.ExitRotation, e),
		Scale = lerp(scale, c.ExitScale, e),
		Transparency = e,
		Depth = lerp(depth, 1.5, e),
		ShineY = 0,
	}
end

local function startPose(t: number): Pose
	local c = COUNTDOWN
	local center = c.EndPoint

	if t < c.StartPunchTime then
		local u = t / c.StartPunchTime
		local e = easeOutCubic(u)
		return {
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(center.X, center.Y),
			Rotation = -8 * (1 - e),
			Scale = lerp(0.15, c.StartPeakScale, e),
			Transparency = 1 - clamp01(u / 0.4),
			Depth = lerp(2.0, 1.6, u),
			ShineY = c.ShineStart,
		}
	end

	local ti = t - c.StartPunchTime
	local k = springKick(ti, 18, 0.36)
	local push = lerp(c.StartRestScale, c.StartPushScale, clamp01(ti / 0.6))
	local scale = push + (c.StartPeakScale - c.StartRestScale) * k
	local shake = 0.006 * k
	local transparency = 0

	local exitStart = c.StartTotal - c.StartExitTime
	if t >= exitStart then
		local v = clamp01((t - exitStart) / c.StartExitTime)
		local e = v * v
		scale *= lerp(1, 1.4, e)
		transparency = e
	end

	return {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(center.X + shake * math.sin(ti * 95), center.Y + shake * math.cos(ti * 83)),
		Rotation = 3 * k * math.sin(ti * 60),
		Scale = scale,
		Transparency = transparency,
		Depth = 1.25 - 0.95 * k,
		ShineY = lerp(c.ShineStart, 0, easeOutCubic(clamp01(ti / c.ShineTime))),
	}
end

local function paletteForNumber(remaining: number): Palette
	local main: Color3
	local shadow: Color3
	if remaining <= 2 then
		main = Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95)
		shadow = Color3.fromRGB(130, 25, 25)
	else
		main = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60)
		shadow = Color3.fromRGB(130, 65, 10)
	end
	return {
		Main = main,
		Shadow = shadow,
		Deep = shadow:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55),
		Accent = main:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65),
	}
end

-- ===== Construccion de capas (se crean UNA vez y se reutilizan) =====

local function copyTextStyle(target: TextLabel, source: TextLabel)
	target.FontFace = source.FontFace
	target.TextSize = source.TextSize
	target.TextScaled = source.TextScaled
	target.TextWrapped = source.TextWrapped
	target.LineHeight = source.LineHeight
	target.TextXAlignment = source.TextXAlignment
	target.TextYAlignment = source.TextYAlignment
	target.RichText = false
end

local function newStack(name: string, container: Frame, source: TextLabel, layerCount: number, baseZ: number, outlined: boolean): FxStack
	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = name
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.AnchorPoint = source.AnchorPoint
	root.Size = source.Size
	root.Position = source.Position
	root.ZIndex = baseZ
	root.Visible = false

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Name = "UIScale"
	scale.Parent = root

	local layers: { TextLabel } = {}
	local stroke: UIStroke? = nil
	for i = 1, layerCount do
		local layer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		layer.Name = "Layer" .. i
		layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
		layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		layer.ZIndex = baseZ + (layerCount - i) -- la capa 1 (pegada a la cara) queda arriba
		layer.Text = ""
		copyTextStyle(layer, source)
		if outlined and i == layerCount then
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			s.Name = "DeepStroke"
			s.Thickness = 4
			s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(10, 6, 3)
			s.Parent = layer
			stroke = s
		end
		layer.Parent = root
		table.insert(layers, layer)
	end

	root.Parent = container
	return { Root = root, Scale = scale, Layers = layers, Stroke = stroke }
end

local function newBurst(container: Frame): BurstFx
	local burst = Instance.new("Frame")
	burst.Name = "Burst"
	burst.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	burst.BorderSizePixel = 0
	burst.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	burst.ZIndex = 3
	burst.Visible = false
	burst.Parent = container

	local rings: { Frame } = {}
	local ringStrokes: { UIStroke } = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "Ring" .. i
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
		ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		ring.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY -- circulo perfecto en cualquier resolucion
		ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1)
		ring.ZIndex = 4
		ring.Visible = false

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		corner.Parent = ring

		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 8
		stroke.Parent = ring

		ring.Parent = burst
		table.insert(rings, ring)
		table.insert(ringStrokes, stroke)
	end

	local rng = Random.new(1337)
	local sparks: { Frame } = {}
	local angles: { number } = {}
	local reach: { number } = {}
	for i = 1, COUNTDOWN.SparkCount do
		local spark = Instance.new("Frame")
		spark.Name = "Spark" .. i
		spark.BorderSizePixel = 0
		spark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		spark.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
		spark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.012)
		spark.ZIndex = 5
		spark.Visible = false

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		corner.Parent = spark

		spark.Parent = burst
		table.insert(sparks, spark)
		table.insert(angles, (i - 1) / COUNTDOWN.SparkCount * math.pi * 2 + rng:NextNumber(-0.12, 0.12))
		table.insert(reach, rng:NextNumber(0.26, 0.48))
	end

	return { Container = burst, Rings = rings, RingStrokes = ringStrokes, Sparks = sparks, SparkAngles = angles, SparkReach = reach }
end

local function buildCountdownFx(frame: Frame, label: TextLabel): CountdownFx
	-- Limpieza de restos (evita duplicados si el controlador se reinicia)
	local staleFx = frame:FindFirstChild("CountdownFx")
	if staleFx then
		staleFx:Destroy()
	end
	local staleShadow = label:FindFirstChild("Shadow3D")
	if staleShadow then
		staleShadow:Destroy()
	end

	-- El label siempre por encima de las capas FX (vale para ZIndexBehavior Sibling y Global)
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.ZIndex = math.max(label.ZIndex, 50)

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "CountdownFx"
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.BorderSizePixel = 0
	container.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	container.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	container.ZIndex = 2
	container.Parent = frame

	local burst = newBurst(container)
	local extrusion = newStack("Extrusion", container, label, COUNTDOWN.DepthLayers, 10, true)
	local ghosts: { FxStack } = {}
	for g = 1, COUNTDOWN.GhostCount do
		table.insert(ghosts, newStack("Ghost" .. g, container, label, 1, 30 + g, false))
	end

	return { Container = container, Extrusion = extrusion, Ghosts = ghosts, Burst = burst }
end

-- ===== Sincronizacion label <-> capas =====

local function paintRig(rig: CountdownRig, text: string, palette: Palette)
	local label = rig.Label
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = palette.Main

	local layers = rig.Fx.Extrusion.Layers
	local n = #layers
	for i, layer in ipairs(layers) do
		copyTextStyle(layer, label)
		layer.Text = text
		layer.TextColor3 = palette.Shadow:Lerp(palette.Deep, if n > 1 then (i - 1) / (n - 1) else 0)
	end

	for _, ghost in ipairs(rig.Fx.Ghosts) do
		for _, layer in ipairs(ghost.Layers) do
			copyTextStyle(layer, label)
			layer.Text = text
			layer.TextColor3 = palette.Main
		end
	end

	local burst = rig.Fx.Burst
	burst.RingStrokes[1].Color = palette.Accent
	burst.RingStrokes[2].Color = palette.Main
	for i, spark in ipairs(burst.Sparks) do
		spark.BackgroundColor3 = if i % 2 == 0 then palette.Accent else palette.Main
	end
end

local function applyPose(rig: CountdownRig, pose: Pose)
	local label = rig.Label
	label.Position = pose.Position
	label.Rotation = pose.Rotation
	rig.UIScale.Scale = pose.Scale
	label.TextTransparency = pose.Transparency
	if rig.Stroke then
		rig.Stroke.Transparency = pose.Transparency
	end
	if rig.Gradient then
		rig.Gradient.Offset = Vector2.new(0, pose.ShineY)
	end

	local ext = rig.Fx.Extrusion
	ext.Root.Visible = pose.Transparency < 0.999
	ext.Root.Position = pose.Position
	ext.Root.Rotation = pose.Rotation
	ext.Scale.Scale = pose.Scale
	for i, layer in ipairs(ext.Layers) do
		layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, COUNTDOWN.DepthStep * i * pose.Depth)
		layer.TextTransparency = pose.Transparency
	end
	if ext.Stroke then
		ext.Stroke.Transparency = pose.Transparency
	end
end

local function updateGhosts(rig: CountdownRig, t: number)
	local c = COUNTDOWN
	for g, ghost in ipairs(rig.Fx.Ghosts) do
		local u = t / c.EnterTime - c.GhostLag * g
		local visible = t < c.EnterTime and u > 0
		ghost.Root.Visible = visible
		if visible then
			local s = u ^ c.EnterEase
			local p = flightPoint(s)
			ghost.Root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.X, p.Y)
			ghost.Root.Rotation = flightTilt(s)
			ghost.Scale.Scale = lerp(c.FlightStartScale, 1 + c.ImpactScale, 1 - (1 - u) ^ 2)
			local transparency = math.max(c.GhostTransparency + (g - 1) * 0.12, 1 - clamp01(u / c.FadeInPortion))
			for _, layer in ipairs(ghost.Layers) do
				layer.TextTransparency = transparency
			end
		end
	end
end

local function hideGhosts(rig: CountdownRig)
	for _, ghost in ipairs(rig.Fx.Ghosts) do
		ghost.Root.Visible = false
	end
end

local RING_TIMING = {
	{ delay = 0, duration = 0.45, size = 2.2 },
	{ delay = 0.07, duration = 0.50, size = 1.5 },
}

local function updateBurst(rig: CountdownRig, t: number)
	local burst = rig.Fx.Burst
	burst.Container.Visible = true

	for i, ring in ipairs(burst.Rings) do
		local timing = RING_TIMING[i]
		local w = clamp01((t - timing.delay) / timing.duration)
		ring.Visible = t >= timing.delay and w < 1
		if ring.Visible then
			local e = easeOutCubic(w)
			local d = lerp(0.18, timing.size, e)
			ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(d, d)
			burst.RingStrokes[i].Thickness = lerp(14, 1, w)
			burst.RingStrokes[i].Transparency = lerp(0.1, 1, w)
		end
	end

	local abs = rig.Frame.AbsoluteSize
	local aspect = if abs.X > 0 then abs.Y / abs.X else 1
	local w = clamp01((t - 0.02) / 0.5)
	local e = easeOutCubic(w)
	for i, spark in ipairs(burst.Sparks) do
		spark.Visible = t > 0.02 and w < 1
		if spark.Visible then
			local angle = burst.SparkAngles[i]
			local dist = burst.SparkReach[i] * e
			spark.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * dist * aspect, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * dist)
			spark.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
			spark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.06 * (1 - 0.7 * w), 0.012)
			spark.BackgroundTransparency = w * w
		end
	end
end

local function hideBurst(rig: CountdownRig)
	local burst = rig.Fx.Burst
	burst.Container.Visible = false
	for _, ring in ipairs(burst.Rings) do
		ring.Visible = false
	end
	for _, spark in ipairs(burst.Sparks) do
		spark.Visible = false
	end
end

function MatchController:_getCountdownRig(): CountdownRig?
	local frame = self._startCountdownFrame
	local label = self._startCountdownLabel
	if not frame or not label then
		return nil
	end

	local fx = self._countdownFx
	if not fx or fx.Container.Parent ~= frame then
		fx = buildCountdownFx(frame, label)
		self._countdownFx = fx
	end

	local uiScale = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not uiScale then
		uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		uiScale.Parent = label
	end

	return {
		Frame = frame,
		Label = label,
		UIScale = uiScale :: UIScale,
		Stroke = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"),
		Gradient = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient"),
		Fx = fx :: CountdownFx,
	}
end

function MatchController:_stopStartCountdownAnimation()
	self._countdownAnimToken += 1
	local conn = self._countdownConn
	if conn then
		conn:Disconnect()
		self._countdownConn = nil
	end
end

function MatchController:_updateStartCountdown(remaining: number, extraData: any?)
	local frame = self._startCountdownFrame
	if not frame or not self._startCountdownLabel then
		return
	end

	local isStarted = (remaining == 0) or (extraData and extraData.Started == true)
	local isPointRestart = (extraData and extraData.Phase == "PointRestart")
		or (self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.PointRestartCountdown)

	frame.Visible = true

	if self._startCountdownTitle then
		self._startCountdownTitle.Text = if isPointRestart then "SIGUIENTE PUNTO EN" else "LA PARTIDA COMIENZA"
	end

	local rig = self:_getCountdownRig()
	if not rig then
		return
	end

	-- Cancela cualquier animacion previa y reclama un token nuevo
	self:_stopStartCountdownAnimation()
	local myToken = self._countdownAnimToken

	local palette = if isStarted then START_PALETTE else paletteForNumber(remaining)
	paintRig(rig, if isStarted then "¡COMIENZA!" else tostring(remaining), palette)
	rig.Fx.Extrusion.Root.Visible = false
	hideGhosts(rig)
	hideBurst(rig)

	local startClock = os.clock()

	-- Un fotograma: devuelve true cuando la animacion termino
	local function step(): boolean
		local t = os.clock() - startClock
		if isStarted then
			applyPose(rig, startPose(t))
			updateBurst(rig, t)
			return t >= COUNTDOWN.StartTotal
		end
		applyPose(rig, numberPose(t))
		updateGhosts(rig, t)
		return t >= NUMBER_TOTAL
	end

	local function finish()
		hideGhosts(rig)
		hideBurst(rig)
		if isStarted
			and (self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.Playing or self._currentState == Constants.RoundState.Waiting)
		then
			frame.Visible = false
			rig.UIScale.Scale = 1
		end
	end

	-- Primer fotograma inmediato: el label nunca se ve un frame en la pose anterior
	if step() then
		finish()
		return
	end

	local conn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if self._countdownAnimToken ~= myToken then
			if conn then
				conn:Disconnect()
			end
			return
		end
		if step() then
			if conn then
				conn:Disconnect()
			end
			if self._countdownConn == conn then
				self._countdownConn = nil
			end
			finish()
		end
	end)
	self._countdownConn = conn
end

function MatchController:_clearClonedButtons()
	for _, btn in pairs(self._clonedButtons) do
		btn:Destroy()
	end
	self._clonedButtons = {}
end

function MatchController:_populateMapSelection(maps: { string })
	if not self._mapsContainer or not self._mapButtonTemplate then return end

	self:_clearClonedButtons()

	for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
		local btn = self._mapButtonTemplate:Clone()
		btn.Name = "Btn_" .. mapName

		local mapNameLabel = btn:FindFirstChild("MapName") :: TextLabel?
		if mapNameLabel then
			mapNameLabel.Text = mapName
		end

		btn.Visible = true
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			self:_submitVote(mapName, btn)
		end)

		btn.Parent = self._mapsContainer
		self._clonedButtons[mapName] = btn
	end
end

function MatchController:_submitVote(votePayload: string, clickedButton: TextButton?)
	local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local matchFolder = remotesFolder and remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("Match")
	local mapSelection = matchFolder and matchFolder:FindFirstChild("MapSelection") :: RemoteEvent?

	if mapSelection and self._currentMatchId then
		mapSelection:FireServer(votePayload, self._currentMatchId)
	else
		return
	end

	self:_highlightSelectedVote(votePayload)
end

function MatchController:_resetButtonHighlights()
	if self._randomButton then
		local stroke = self._randomButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		self._randomButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80)
		if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 120, 180); stroke.Thickness = 1.5 end
	end

	for _, btn in pairs(self._clonedButtons) do
		local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 38, 55)
		if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 120); stroke.Thickness = 1 end
	end
end

function MatchController:_highlightSelectedVote(votePayload: string)
	self._selectedMapVote = votePayload
	self:_resetButtonHighlights()

	if votePayload == Constants.SpecialMapVote.Random or votePayload == "Aleatorio" then
		if self._randomButton then
			local stroke = self._randomButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			self._randomButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 100, 180)
			if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255); stroke.Thickness = 2 end
		end
	else
		local btn = self._clonedButtons[votePayload]
		if btn then
			local stroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 160)
			if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255); stroke.Thickness = 2 end
		end
	end
end

function MatchController:_handleMatchResult(result: string, winnerName: string?)
	if not self._resultFrame or not self._resultTitle or not self._resultSubtitle then return end

	local stroke = self._resultFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

	if result == Constants.MatchResult.Draw then
		self._resultTitle.Text = "EMPATE"
		self._resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215)
		self._resultSubtitle.Text = "Se agoto el tiempo de la partida"
		if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 180) end

	elseif result == Constants.MatchResult.Cancelled then
		self._resultTitle.Text = "CANCELADO"
		self._resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 100)
		self._resultSubtitle.Text = "Un jugador abandono la partida"
		if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60) end

	else
		local myRole = self._currentRole
		local isWinner = false

		if myRole and result == myRole then
			isWinner = true
		end

		if isWinner then
			self._resultTitle.Text = "VICTORIA"
			self._resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
			self._resultSubtitle.Text = string.format("¡Has ganado la partida contra %s!", winnerName == localPlayer.Name and "tu oponente" or (winnerName or ""))
			if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) end
		else
			self._resultTitle.Text = "DERROTA"
			self._resultTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 70)
			self._resultSubtitle.Text = string.format("Ganador: %s", winnerName or result)
			if stroke then stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50) end
		end
	end

	self._resultFrame.Visible = true
end

return MatchController

function MusicController:_registerSound(sound: Instance)
	if sound:IsA("Sound") then
		if self._baseVolumes[sound] == nil then
			-- Almacenar el volumen original de Studio como referencia inmutable
			local baseVol = sound.Volume
			if baseVol <= 0 then
				baseVol = 0.35
			end
			self._baseVolumes[sound] = baseVol
		end
	end
end

function MusicController:_cacheAllSounds()
	local musicFolder = self:_getMusicFolder()
	if not musicFolder then return end

	for _, desc in ipairs(musicFolder:GetDescendants()) do
		self:_registerSound(desc)
	end

	musicFolder.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
		self:_registerSound(desc)
	end)
end

function MusicController:_getSoundInstance(name: string): Sound?
	local musicFolder = self:_getMusicFolder()
	if not musicFolder then return nil end
	local sound = musicFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if sound and sound:IsA("Sound") then
		self:_registerSound(sound)
		return sound
	end
	return nil
end

function MusicController:_getArenaSound(mapName: string): Sound?
	local arenasFolder = self:_getArenasFolder()
	if not arenasFolder then return nil end

	-- 1. Coincidencia exacta con el nombre del mapa
	local sound = arenasFolder:FindFirstChild(mapName)
	if sound and sound:IsA("Sound") then
		self:_registerSound(sound)
		return sound
	end

	-- 2. Fallback opcional a "ArenaDefault" o "Default"
	local fallback = arenasFolder:FindFirstChild("ArenaDefault") or arenasFolder:FindFirstChild("Default")
	if fallback and fallback:IsA("Sound") then
		self:_registerSound(fallback)
		return fallback
	end

	return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Cálculo de Volumen
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function MusicController:_getTargetVolume(sound: Sound): number
	if not self._musicEnabled then
		return 0
	end

	local baseVolume = self._baseVolumes[sound] or sound.Volume
	local userVol = math.clamp(self._userMusicVolume, 0, 1)
	return baseVolume * userVol
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Transiciones y Cross-Fade
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function MusicController:_cancelTweenForSound(sound: Sound)
	local active = self._activeTweens[sound]
	if active then
		active:Cancel()
		active:Destroy()
		self._activeTweens[sound] = nil
	end
end

function MusicController:_getAllManagedSounds(): { Sound }
	local sounds: { Sound } = {}
	local musicFolder = self:_getMusicFolder()
	if musicFolder then
		for _, desc in ipairs(musicFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("Sound") then
				table.insert(sounds, desc)
			end
		end
	end
	return sounds
end

function MusicController:_transitionTo(newSound: Sound?, newState: MusicState, fadeDuration: number?)
	local duration = fadeDuration or DEFAULT_FADE_DURATION

	self._transitionToken += 1
	local thisToken = self._transitionToken

	self._currentState = newState
	self._currentSound = newSound

	-- 1. Fade Out de todos los sonidos activos que NO sean el nuevo sonido
	for _, sound in ipairs(self:_getAllManagedSounds()) do
		if sound ~= newSound then
			self:_cancelTweenForSound(sound)

			if sound.IsPlaying or sound.Volume > 0 then
				if duration > 0 then
					local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, FADE_EASING_STYLE, FADE_EASING_DIR)
					local fadeOutTween = TweenService:Create(sound, tweenInfo, { Volume = 0 })
					self._activeTweens[sound] = fadeOutTween

					fadeOutTween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if self._activeTweens[sound] == fadeOutTween then
							self._activeTweens[sound] = nil
						end
						if self._transitionToken == thisToken and sound ~= self._currentSound then
							pcall(function()
								sound:Stop()
							end)
						end
						fadeOutTween:Destroy()
					end)

					fadeOutTween:Play()
				else
					sound.Volume = 0
					pcall(function()
						sound:Stop()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 2. Fade In del nuevo sonido si existe
	if newSound then
		self:_cancelTweenForSound(newSound)

		local targetVol = self:_getTargetVolume(newSound)

		if self._musicEnabled and targetVol > 0 then
			newSound.Looped = true
			if not newSound.IsPlaying then
				newSound.Volume = 0
				pcall(function()
					newSound:Play()
				end)
			end

			if duration > 0 then
				local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, FADE_EASING_STYLE, FADE_EASING_DIR)
				local fadeInTween = TweenService:Create(newSound, tweenInfo, { Volume = targetVol })
				self._activeTweens[newSound] = fadeInTween

				fadeInTween.Completed:Connect(function()
					if self._activeTweens[newSound] == fadeInTween then
						self._activeTweens[newSound] = nil
					end
					fadeInTween:Destroy()
				end)

				fadeInTween:Play()
			else
				newSound.Volume = targetVol
			end
		else
			-- Música deshabilitada o target volume = 0
			newSound.Volume = 0
			if newSound.IsPlaying then
				pcall(function()
					newSound:Stop()
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

function MusicController:IsSuspended(reason: string?): boolean
	if reason then
		return self._suspensions[reason] ~= nil
	end
	for _ in pairs(self._suspensions) do
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function MusicController:Suspend(reason: string?, fadeDuration: number?): number
	local r = reason or "Default"
	self._suspensionTokenCounter += 1
	local token = self._suspensionTokenCounter

	local record = self._suspensions[r]
	if not record then
		self._suspensions[r] = {
			Token = token,
			PreviousState = self._currentState,
			PreviousMap = self._currentMapName,
			PreviousSound = self._currentSound,
		}
	else
		record.Token = token
	end

	local duration = if fadeDuration ~= nil then fadeDuration else 0.4
	self:_transitionTo(nil, "None", duration)
	print(string.format("[MusicController] Música suspendida por '%s' (Token=%d, Fade=%.2fs)", r, token, duration))
	return token
end

function MusicController:Resume(reason: string?, token: number?, restoreFadeDuration: number?): boolean
	local r = reason or "Default"
	local record = self._suspensions[r]
	if not record then
		return false
	end

	if token ~= nil and record.Token ~= token then
		-- Token desactualizado: pertenece a una ejecución anterior ya superada
		return false
	end

	local previousState = record.PreviousState
	local previousMap = record.PreviousMap
	self._suspensions[r] = nil
	print(string.format("[MusicController] Suspensión '%s' liberada", r))

	if self:IsSuspended() then
		return true
	end

	local duration = if restoreFadeDuration ~= nil then restoreFadeDuration else 0.6
	local pending = self._pendingMusicState
	self._pendingMusicState = nil

	if pending and pending.State ~= "None" then
		local pDuration = pending.FadeDuration or duration
		if pending.State == "Lobby" then
			self:PlayLobby(pDuration)
		elseif pending.State == "Matchmaking" then
			self:PlayMatchmaking(pDuration)
		elseif pending.State == "Arena" and pending.MapName then
			self:PlayArena(pending.MapName, pDuration)
		end
	elseif r == "EndCinematicPreview" then
		if previousState == "Lobby" then
			self:PlayLobby(duration)
		elseif previousState == "Matchmaking" then
			self:PlayMatchmaking(duration)
		elseif previousState == "Arena" and previousMap then
			self:PlayArena(previousMap, duration)
		else
			self:Stop(duration)
		end
	else
		local inMatch = false
		local matchController = self:_getMatchController()
		if matchController and typeof(matchController.IsParticipant) == "function" then
			inMatch = matchController:IsParticipant()
		end
		if Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= nil then
			inMatch = true
		end

		local mmController = self:_getMatchmakingController()
		local inQueue = mmController and typeof(mmController.IsInQueue) == "function" and mmController:IsInQueue()

		if inMatch then
			local selectedMap = matchController and matchController:GetCurrentSelectedMap() or "Default"
			self:PlayArena(selectedMap, duration)
		elseif inQueue then
			self:PlayMatchmaking(duration)
		else
			self:PlayLobby(duration)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function MusicController:PlayLobby(fadeDuration: number?)
	if self:IsSuspended() then
		self._pendingMusicState = { State = "Lobby", MapName = nil, FadeDuration = fadeDuration }
		print("[MusicController] PlayLobby recibido durante suspensión; encolado")
		return
	end

	local lobbySound = self:_getSoundInstance("Lobby")
	if self._currentState == "Lobby" and self._currentSound == lobbySound and lobbySound and lobbySound.IsPlaying then
		return
	end

	self._currentMapName = nil
	self:_transitionTo(lobbySound, "Lobby", fadeDuration)
	print("[MusicController] Reproduciendo música de Lobby")
end

function MusicController:PlayMatchmaking(fadeDuration: number?)
	if self:IsSuspended() then
		self._pendingMusicState = { State = "Matchmaking", MapName = nil, FadeDuration = fadeDuration }
		print("[MusicController] PlayMatchmaking recibido durante suspensión; encolado")
		return
	end

	local mmSound = self:_getSoundInstance("Matchmaking")
	if self._currentState == "Matchmaking" and self._currentSound == mmSound and mmSound and mmSound.IsPlaying then
		return
	end

	self._currentMapName = nil
	self:_transitionTo(mmSound, "Matchmaking", fadeDuration)
	print("[MusicController] Reproduciendo música de Matchmaking")
end

function MusicController:PlayArena(mapName: string, fadeDuration: number?)
	if self:IsSuspended() then
		self._pendingMusicState = { State = "Arena", MapName = mapName, FadeDuration = fadeDuration }
		print(string.format("[MusicController] PlayArena(%s) recibido durante suspensión; encolado", mapName))
		return
	end

	local arenaSound = self:_getArenaSound(mapName)
	if self._currentState == "Arena" and self._currentMapName == mapName and self._currentSound == arenaSound and arenaSound and arenaSound.IsPlaying then
		return
	end

	self._currentMapName = mapName
	if not arenaSound then
		warn(string.format("[MusicController] No se encontro musica para la arena '%s'. Permaneciendo en silencio.", mapName))
		self:_transitionTo(nil, "Arena", fadeDuration)
		return
	end

	self:_transitionTo(arenaSound, "Arena", fadeDuration)
	print(string.format("[MusicController] Reproduciendo música de Arena: %s", mapName))
end

function MusicController:Stop(fadeDuration: number?)
	if self:IsSuspended() then
		self._pendingMusicState = { State = "None", MapName = nil, FadeDuration = fadeDuration }
		return
	end

	self._currentMapName = nil
	self:_transitionTo(nil, "None", fadeDuration)
	print("[MusicController] Música detenida")
end

function MusicController:SetMusicEnabled(enabled: boolean, fadeDuration: number?)
	if self._musicEnabled == enabled then return end
	self._musicEnabled = enabled
	print(string.format("[MusicController] MusicEnabled establecido en %s", tostring(enabled)))

	if self:IsSuspended() then
		return
	end

	local duration = if fadeDuration ~= nil then fadeDuration else 0.4

	if not enabled then
		-- Desvanecer suavemente la pista actual a 0 y pausar
		if self._currentSound and self._currentSound.IsPlaying then
			self:_cancelTweenForSound(self._currentSound)
			if duration > 0 then
				local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, FADE_EASING_STYLE, FADE_EASING_DIR)
				local muteTween = TweenService:Create(self._currentSound, tweenInfo, { Volume = 0 })
				self._activeTweens[self._currentSound] = muteTween
				local soundRef = self._currentSound
				muteTween.Completed:Connect(function()
					if self._activeTweens[soundRef] == muteTween then
						self._activeTweens[soundRef] = nil
					end
					if not self._musicEnabled and soundRef then
						soundRef:Stop()
					end
					muteTween:Destroy()
				end)
				muteTween:Play()
			else
				self._currentSound.Volume = 0
				self._currentSound:Stop()
			end
		end
	else
		-- Reanudar o fade in hacia el volumen objetivo
		if self._currentSound then
			local targetVol = self:_getTargetVolume(self._currentSound)
			if targetVol > 0 then
				if not self._currentSound.IsPlaying then
					self._currentSound.Volume = 0
					self._currentSound:Play()
				end
				self:_cancelTweenForSound(self._currentSound)
				if duration > 0 then
					local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, FADE_EASING_STYLE, FADE_EASING_DIR)
					local resumeTween = TweenService:Create(self._currentSound, tweenInfo, { Volume = targetVol })
					self._activeTweens[self._currentSound] = resumeTween
					local soundRef = self._currentSound
					resumeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if self._activeTweens[soundRef] == resumeTween then
							self._activeTweens[soundRef] = nil
						end
						resumeTween:Destroy()
					end)
					resumeTween:Play()
				else
					self._currentSound.Volume = targetVol
				end
			end
		else
			-- Si no había un track reproduciendo, volver al estado actual
			if self._currentState == "Lobby" then
				self:PlayLobby(duration)
			elseif self._currentState == "Matchmaking" then
				self:PlayMatchmaking(duration)
			elseif self._currentState == "Arena" and self._currentMapName then
				self:PlayArena(self._currentMapName, duration)
			end
		end
	end
end

function MusicController:SetMusicVolume(volume: number, fadeDuration: number?)
	local clamped = math.clamp(volume, 0, 1)
	self._userMusicVolume = clamped
	print(string.format("[MusicController] MusicVolume establecido en %.2f", clamped))

	local duration = if fadeDuration ~= nil then fadeDuration else 0.2

	if self._currentSound and self._currentSound.IsPlaying and self._musicEnabled then
		local targetVol = self:_getTargetVolume(self._currentSound)
		self:_cancelTweenForSound(self._currentSound)
		if duration > 0 then
			local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, FADE_EASING_STYLE, FADE_EASING_DIR)
			local volTween = TweenService:Create(self._currentSound, tweenInfo, { Volume = targetVol })
			self._activeTweens[self._currentSound] = volTween
			local soundRef = self._currentSound
			volTween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if self._activeTweens[soundRef] == volTween then
					self._activeTweens[soundRef] = nil
				end
				volTween:Destroy()
			end)
			volTween:Play()
		else
			self._currentSound.Volume = targetVol
		end
	end
end

end

	return self._currentMapName

function MusicController:Start(context: any)
	self._context = context

	-- Sincronización inicial segura
	local matchController = context and context:GetController("MatchController")
	local mmController = context and context:GetController("MatchmakingController")

	local inMatch = matchController and typeof(matchController.IsParticipant) == "function" and matchController:IsParticipant()
	local inQueue = mmController and typeof(mmController.IsInQueue) == "function" and mmController:IsInQueue()

	if inMatch then
		local selectedMap = matchController:GetCurrentSelectedMap() or "Default"
		self:PlayArena(selectedMap)
	elseif inQueue then
		self:PlayMatchmaking()
	else
		-- Estado predeterminado al entrar al juego
		self:PlayLobby()
	end

	print(string.format("[MusicController] Iniciado en estado: %s", self._currentState))
end

return MusicController

--!strict
-- SlapController
-- Controlador cliente de Slaps.
-- Responsabilidad exclusiva:
-- 1. Detectar cuando el jugador equipa un Slap (Tool con Configuration.Power).
-- 2. Conectar al evento Tool.Activated.
-- 3. Reproducir localmente la animacion de golpe (Swing) para retroalimentacion visual instantanea.
-- 4. Solicitar la ejecucion autoritativa al servidor via ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Combat.PerformSlap.
-- 5. Manejar un debounce local liviano para evitar saturar la red con clics repetidos.
-- NO calcula daño, distancia autoritativa, knockback ni fisica.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local SlapController = {}
SlapController.Name = "SlapController"

SlapController._context = nil :: any
SlapController._performSlapRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
SlapController._equippedTool = nil :: Tool?
SlapController._activatedConn = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
SlapController._swingTrack = nil :: AnimationTrack?
SlapController._localNextSlapTime = 0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Remotes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function SlapController:_getPerformRemote(): RemoteEvent?
	if self._performSlapRemote then return self._performSlapRemote end

	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5) :: Folder?
	local combat = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("Combat", 5) :: Folder?
	local remote = combat and combat:WaitForChild("PerformSlap", 5) :: RemoteEvent?
	if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		self._performSlapRemote = remote
		return remote
	end
	return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Animaciones y Ciclo del Tool
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function isSlapTool(tool: Instance): boolean
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	if config and config:FindFirstChild("Power") then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function SlapController:_onToolEquipped(tool: Tool)
	if not isSlapTool(tool) then return end

	self:_onToolUnequipped()
	self._equippedTool = tool

	-- Preparar animacion de swing si existe
	local swingAnim = tool:FindFirstChild("Swing") :: Animation?
	local char = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if swingAnim and swingAnim:IsA("Animation") and animator then
		local ok, track = pcall(function()
			return animator:LoadAnimation(swingAnim)
		end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			self._swingTrack = track
		end
	end

	-- Conectar activacion del Tool
	self._activatedConn = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:_onToolActivated(tool)
	end)
end

function SlapController:_onToolUnequipped()
	if self._activatedConn then
		self._activatedConn:Disconnect()
		self._activatedConn = nil
	end

	if self._swingTrack then
		pcall(function()
			self._swingTrack:Stop(0.1)
		end)
		self._swingTrack = nil
	end

	self._equippedTool = nil
end

function SlapController:_onToolActivated(tool: Tool)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < self._localNextSlapTime then
		return
	end

	-- Leer cooldown configurado para el debounce local
	local config = tool:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
	local cooldownVal = config and config:FindFirstChild("SlapCooldown")
	local cooldown = if cooldownVal and cooldownVal:IsA("NumberValue") then cooldownVal.Value else 0.6
	self._localNextSlapTime = now + cooldown

	-- 1. Feedback visual instantaneo: Reproducir animacion de swing
	if self._swingTrack then
		pcall(function()
			self._swingTrack:Play(0.05, 1, 1.2)
		end)
	end

	-- 2. Solicitar al servidor la validacion y ejecucion del golpe
	local remote = self:_getPerformRemote()
	if remote then
		remote:FireServer(tool)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enlace de Personaje
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function SlapController:_bindCharacter(character: Model)
	self:_onToolUnequipped()

	-- Detectar herramientas equipadas
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Tool") then
			self:_onToolEquipped(child)
		end
	end)

	character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
		if child == self._equippedTool then
			self:_onToolUnequipped()
		end
	end)

	-- Si ya tenia una herramienta equipada al iniciar
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Tool") then
			self:_onToolEquipped(child)
			break
		end
	end
end

-- Ciclo de Vida Bootstrap
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function SlapController:Init(context: any)
	self._context = context
	self:_getPerformRemote()
end

function SlapController:Start(context: any)
	self._context = context

	if localPlayer.Character then
		self:_bindCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
	end

	localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		self:_bindCharacter(char)
	end)

	print("[SlapController] Controlador de Slaps iniciado y listo")
end

return SlapController
